Step 5 - Save Your Application Take a printout of the system-generated online application form after submitting. Do not make multiple submissions; only the last valid completed application will be retained.

Selection Process for Central Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Selection involves multiple stages. Candidates must clear all stages to be engaged as apprentices.

Stage 1 - Online Written Examination

The exam is objective type, conducted by BFSI SSC. It will be taken from the candidate's own home on their own device - no admit card or examination centre is required.

Subject Questions Marks Duration
General / Financial Awareness 20 20 -
Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 20 20 -
Computer Knowledge 20 20 -
General English 20 20 -
Central Bank of India Products & Services 20 20 -
Total 100 100 60 minutes
  • Medium: English/Hindi (General English section in English only)
  • No negative marking for wrong answers
  • Tie-breaking rule: if two candidates score equally, the older candidate ranks higher (descending order of age)
  • Details on CBI Products & Services will be shared on the bank's official website in due course

Stage 2 - Test of Local Language

Candidates must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, and understanding) in the specified official language of the state they apply for. This test is conducted after qualifying the online exam at a centre decided by the bank, at the candidate's own expense.

Candidates who have studied the specified local language at the 10th or 12th standard level (as evidenced by mark sheets) are exempt from the language test.

Stage 3 - Document Verification

Qualified candidates are called to the relevant CBI Regional/Zonal Office for verification of all original documents, including date of birth proof, graduation certificates, category certificates, and any other relevant documents.

Stage 4 - Medical Fitness Verification

Final engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a qualified medical practitioner or MBBS doctor, as per the bank's requirements.

Stipend, Training Conditions, and Benefits

Understanding what to expect during the apprenticeship helps candidates plan ahead.

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹15,000 per month for the 12-month training period
  • No other allowances or employee benefits are provided
  • Leave: One casual leave per month; public/bank holidays as applicable; no other leave types
  • Working hours: Same as clerical staff of the bank; no overtime is permitted
  • No hostel, transport, or residential accommodation is provided by the bank
  • An assessment test may be conducted after completion, followed by certification as per prevailing guidelines
  • Apprentices are trainees, not employees - no labour laws or employee benefits apply
  • Apprentices cannot form or join any union

Contract of Apprenticeship

Candidates selected after document verification will receive a digital apprenticeship contract through the NATS government portal (https://nats.education.gov.in). They must accept the contract within the stipulated timeframe. No candidate can begin training without an approved apprenticeship contract.

Termination Conditions

The contract may be terminated in the following situations:

  • Non-reporting on the date of commencement of On-Job Training
  • Automatic termination on expiry of the 12-month training period
  • Mutual application to the Apprenticeship Advisor (BFSI SSC) before completion, with stated reasons
  • Misconduct by the apprentice, with written notice from the bank
  • If the Apprenticeship Advisor finds either party has failed to fulfil the contract terms

Documents Required at the Time of Document Verification

Candidates must carry originals plus self-attested photocopies of all the following:

  • System-generated printout of online application/NATS enrolment form
  • Date of Birth proof (Birth Certificate or Class X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo identity proof
  • Individual semester/year-wise mark sheets and final degree certificate
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates) in the Government of India prescribed format
  • OBC certificate must explicitly contain the non-creamy layer clause and be valid as on the date of the Language Test (issued within one year)
  • Disability certificate from District Medical Board (for PwBD candidates)
  • Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates) issued by competent authority

Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Under Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, reservation for PwBD is on a horizontal basis within the overall vacancies for each state. The qualifying disability categories include:

  • Visual Impairment (Blindness and Low Vision)
  • Hearing Impairment (Deaf and Hard of Hearing)
  • Orthopedic/Locomotor Disability (OA, OL, BL, OAL)
  • Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy
  • Intellectual Disability (Autism Spectrum Disorder, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness)
  • Multiple Disabilities

A total of 45 seats each are reserved for VI, HI, OH, and ID categories, amounting to 180 PwBD seats across the country.

Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) Eligibility

Candidates not covered under SC/ST/OBC reservation and whose family gross annual income is below ₹8 lakh from all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession) qualify for EWS reservation. Additionally, the family must not own:

  • 5 acres or more of agricultural land
  • A residential flat of 1,000 sq. ft. or more
  • A residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities
  • A residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more outside notified municipalities

The EWS benefit requires an Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued by a competent authority.

Where to Find Updates and Announcements

All announcements, addendums, and corrigenda will be published exclusively on:

  • Central Bank of India official website: Click here (Career section → Current Opportunities)
  • BFSI SSC portal: https://bfsissc.com
  • BEEP portal: https://beep.bfsissc.com (under "My Applied Opportunities")

Bank of Baroda is hiring for 86 vacancies across 5 officer-level posts in its Corporate and Institutional Credit (C&IC) department, ranging from Manager to Chief Manager grade in both Credit Analyst and C&IC Relationship roles. Online registration opened on 16 June 2026, and the last date to apply and pay the fee is 6 July 2026. Eligible candidates need a postgraduate finance qualification or CA/CMA/CS/CFA, relevant banking credit experience, and willingness to serve anywhere in India.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026: Key Dates You Need to Know

This recruitment drive was announced under advertisement number BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/10. There are only two dates that matter for candidates: when the application window opens and when it closes, since the bank has not yet announced an online test date.

Event Date
Online Registration Starts 16 June 2026
Last Date for Application Submission & Fee Payment 6 July 2026

Registration is treated as complete only once the application fee is paid online on or before 6 July 2026; the date of the online test, if conducted, will be announced separately to candidates through their registered email and the bank's website.

86 Vacancies Across 5 Posts: Full Position-wise Breakdown

The 86 vacancies are divided into two job families: Credit Analyst posts and C&IC Relationship posts, each spanning three or two seniority grades respectively. Vacancy count, age limit, and required post-qualification experience vary by grade, so candidates should check the exact post they qualify for before applying.

Credit Analyst Posts (Manager, Senior Manager & Chief Manager)

Credit Analyst posts focus on appraising corporate credit proposals and carry the highest vacancy count in this recruitment, with the Senior Manager grade alone accounting for 38 of the 86 total seats.

C&IC Relationship posts are client-facing roles centred on sourcing and managing corporate borrowers rather than appraising proposals, and together they account for 43 of the 86 vacancies.

Across all 5 posts, work experience of less than 6 months in any organisation as on 1 June 2026 will not count toward eligibility unless it forms part of a candidate's current employment, and time spent in a clerical cadre role is not counted at all.

Eligibility Criteria: Qualification, Age & Work Experience

The educational qualification for Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026 is identical across all 5 posts, while the age limit and experience requirement increase with seniority. Candidates should also note that the bank will only consider qualifications from institutions recognised by the Government of India or bodies like the AICTE.

  • Educational Qualification: Graduation in any discipline, plus a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma with specialisation in Finance (or its equivalent), OR a professional qualification such as CA, CMA, CS, or CFA.
  • Age: Calculated as on 1 June 2026, ranging from a minimum of 25 years (Manager grade) to a maximum of 42 years (Chief Manager grade).
  • Nationality: Indian citizens are eligible, along with certain categories of Nepali, Bhutanese, Tibetan refugee, and Indian-origin candidates from specified countries, subject to an eligibility certificate from the Government of India where applicable.
  • Posting Condition: Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply, since the bank can post selected officers to any branch or office at its discretion.

CIBIL Score Requirement: A Credit History Check Unique to This Recruitment

Unlike most government recruitment notifications, this advertisement makes personal credit history a formal eligibility condition. Candidates need a minimum CIBIL score of 680 at the time of joining the bank, since this post involves handling corporate credit decisions.

Anyone who has defaulted on loan repayments or credit card dues, or who has adverse reports from CIBIL or other external credit assessment agencies, will be treated as ineligible for appointment. The bank has reserved the right to reject a candidate's selection at any stage, including after joining, if their credit profile turns out to be unsatisfactory.

Probation Period and Mandatory Service Bond

Selected candidates do not join in a permanent capacity immediately; they first complete a probation period, and they must also commit to a minimum service period backed by a financial bond.

  • Probation Period: 12 months (1 year) of active service from the date of joining.
  • Service Bond: Candidates must serve the bank for a minimum of 3 years from the date of joining, or pay ₹5 lakh in lieu of completing the bond period.

The exact bond terms will be confirmed in each selected candidate's offer letter and are subject to revision as per the bank's prevailing policy.

Application Fee for Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026

The application fee for this recruitment is fixed by category and must be paid online; it is non-refundable even if the online test is not conducted or the candidate is not shortlisted for an interview.

Selection Process: Online Test, Psychometric Assessment & Interview

Selection for Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026 can include application scrutiny, an online test, a psychometric assessment, a group discussion, and a personal interview, though the bank retains the right to skip or modify any stage. Final selection depends on combined performance across whichever stages are actually conducted.

Online Test Pattern (Tentative)

If a written test is held, it will be a 150-mark, 150-minute online exam split into four sections, three of which only need to be passed rather than scored well in.

2 English Language 25 25

Total 150 225 150 minutes

Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, and Professional Knowledge will be available bilingually in English and Hindi, while the English Language section will be in English only. Sections 1 to 3 are qualifying only and do not count toward the final score; candidates need at least 40% in General/EWS or 35% in Reserved categories to clear each of these sections, and there is no negative marking anywhere in the test.

Personal Interview & Final Merit

Candidates who clear the online test (or are otherwise shortlisted) move on to a psychometric assessment and/or personal interview, where the minimum qualifying score is 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. If two or more candidates tie at the cut-off mark, the older candidate is ranked higher in the merit list.

The online test, if conducted, is tentatively planned across more than two dozen cities, including Mumbai, Delhi/NCR, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar, Jaipur, Lucknow, Baroda, Bhopal, Chandigarh-Mohali, and several other regional centres, with the final allotted centre confirmed in the call letter.

Documents Required During the Recruitment Process

Candidates do not need to upload every certificate while registering online, but they must be ready to produce the following documents in original, along with self-attested photocopies, at the interview stage or whenever the bank asks for them.

  • Printout of the interview call letter and the system-generated online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate, SSLC/Std. X marksheet, or equivalent)
  • A valid photo identity proof such as PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, or Aadhaar card (Ration Card is not accepted)
  • Year-wise/semester-wise mark sheets and the final degree/diploma certificate
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, with the OBC certificate carrying a valid non-creamy-layer clause
  • Disability certificate from the District Medical Board, for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities
  • Income and Asset Certificate, for candidates applying under the EWS category
  • Service/discharge book, pension payment order, and rank proof, for ex-servicemen candidates
  • No Objection Certificate from the current employer, for candidates already working in government, quasi-government, or public sector roles
  • Documentary proof of declared work experience, such as appointment letters, salary slips, or relieving letters

Step-by-Step Guide: How to Apply Online

Bank of Baroda accepts applications for this recruitment only through its official website; no offline or postal applications will be considered.

  1. Visit www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and navigate to the Careers section, then Current Opportunities.
  2. Register using a valid personal email ID and contact number that you can keep active until the recruitment process is complete.
  3. Fill in personal, educational, and work experience details carefully, since no changes are allowed once the form is submitted.
  4. Upload your photograph (200 x 230 pixels, 20-50 KB) and signature (140 x 60 pixels, 10-20 KB) in JPG/JPEG format, signed in your normal handwriting and not in capital letters.
  5. Upload your resume, Date of Birth proof, educational certificates (combined in one PDF), and category/PWD/experience certificates where applicable, each as a PDF on A4 size not exceeding 500 KB.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee online using a Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
  7. Save and print the system-generated application form and fee receipt for your future reference.

Apply Online for Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026

Job Profile: What Will You Actually Do in This Role?

The two job families under this recruitment involve noticeably different day-to-day work, which is worth understanding before choosing which post to apply for.

Credit Analyst roles (Manager/Senior Manager/Chief Manager) are appraisal-focused: examining new and existing corporate credit proposals, conducting credit due-diligence on financial, industry, and business risk, coordinating with Relationship Managers, and ensuring compliance in corporate accounts.

C&IC Relationship roles (Senior Manager/Chief Manager) are client-facing: maintaining relationships with existing corporate clients, sourcing new-to-bank corporate borrowers, cross-selling ancillary business, and creating account plans with opportunity income analysis for corporate borrowers.

Mistakes That Could Cost You This Opportunity

Several avoidable errors can disqualify an otherwise eligible candidate from Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026, so it helps to check these before hitting submit.

  • Assuming any postgraduate degree qualifies - only a finance-specialised PG degree/diploma or a CA/CMA/CS/CFA qualification meets the educational criteria.
  • Not checking your CIBIL score in advance - a score below 680, or any default history, can lead to rejection even after selection.
  • Counting clerical-cadre banking experience toward the eligibility criteria, which is explicitly excluded.
  • Including work experience of less than 6 months from a previous organisation, which will not be counted unless it is part of your current employment.
  • Submitting more than one application - only the latest valid one is retained, and fees paid for earlier ones are forfeited.
  • Selecting a category casually, since no change of category is allowed after registration and an invalid OBC/EWS claim without supporting certificates can affect your candidature.
  • Overlooking the 3-year/₹5 lakh service bond commitment before deciding whether to accept the role if selected.
  • Waiting until the last date to register, risking last-minute website load issues for which the bank takes no responsibility.

What Is an Aadhaar Seva Kendra and Why Does This Role Matter?

Before jumping to the eligibility details, it helps to understand what you are actually applying for. Aadhaar Seva Kendras (ASKs) are dedicated centers set up by UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) across the country where residents can enroll for Aadhaar, update their biometric and demographic information, and avail other Aadhaar-related services.

CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd, a Special Purpose Vehicle under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), operates many of these centers as part of its Digital India mandate. The Aadhaar Supervisor oversees the operations at the ASK and manages operators, while the Aadhaar Operator directly handles resident-facing Aadhaar enrolment and update tasks under UIDAI guidelines.

This is a frontline government service delivery role - one that directly impacts how millions of Indians access identity-linked benefits and services.

Who Is Eligible to Apply? Full Eligibility Criteria Explained

The eligibility requirements for this CSC recruitment are deliberately inclusive, targeting candidates from smaller towns and districts who are already part of the Digital India ecosystem. Here is every condition you need to satisfy.

Age Requirement

Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years of age. There is no upper age limit specified in the notification, making this position accessible to a wider demographic including older candidates seeking re-employment.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must meet one of the following educational qualifications:

Option 1 – Class 12 Pass Intermediate / Senior Secondary certificate from a recognized board.

Option 2 – Matriculation + ITI Class 10 (Matriculation) pass followed by a 2-year Industrial Training Institute (ITI) certificate in any trade.

Option 3 – Matriculation + Polytechnic Diploma Class 10 (Matriculation) pass followed by a 3-year Polytechnic Diploma from a recognized institution.

Mandatory Certification – UIDAI Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate

This is the most critical eligibility condition and the one most candidates miss. You must hold a valid Aadhaar Operator or Supervisor Certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services.

There are two ways to obtain this certification:

Path 1 – Aadhaar Supervisor Exam: You can take the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the UIDAI exam portal. When you apply, an authorization request is sent to the State Team. After their approval, you can appear for the exam at: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Path 2 – Aadhaar LMS Certification: Once your LMS (Learning Management System) ID and password are created and approved, you can appear for the LMS Certification through: https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in

Basic Computer Skills

Candidates must have foundational computer proficiency. This is essential given that all Aadhaar enrolment and update operations are conducted on dedicated UIDAI software.

Who Cannot Apply

VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are explicitly not eligible to apply for this position. This exclusion is clearly stated in all the CSC job postings for this recruitment.

Remuneration: What Will You Earn?

The salary for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator positions is benchmarked against the minimum wages for semi-skilled manpower as notified by the respective state government. This means the actual take-home pay will vary depending on the state where you are posted.

Since each state government periodically revises minimum wage notifications, candidates should check the current semi-skilled minimum wage applicable in their state to understand the exact compensation they can expect. The contract is for 1 year, after which renewal would depend on organizational requirements.

Contract Terms: What to Expect Before You Join

This is a purely contractual engagement for a period of 1 (one) year only. Understanding the nature of this role before applying helps avoid disappointment later.

  • The engagement is with CSC e-Governance Services India Limited, not directly with UIDAI or the Government of India
  • You will be deployed at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) in your assigned district
  • The role involves direct interaction with residents seeking Aadhaar enrolment, biometric updates, and demographic corrections
  • Working under this contract does not automatically lead to regularization or a permanent government job
  • VLEs who are already operating CSC Common Service Centers are ineligible to apply, as these are separate operational roles

How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator 2026

The entire application process is handled through the CSC Career Portal. Here is how to apply step by step.

Step 1: Visit the official CSC career portal at https://career.csccloud.in

Step 2: Browse the active job listings and identify the specific posting for your state and district. Note that Madhya Pradesh has two separate listings - check both to find your district.

Step 3: Click the "Apply Now" button on the relevant job posting page.

Step 4: Complete the application form with your personal, educational, and certification details. Keep your UIDAI Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate details ready for upload.

Step 5: Submit your application before the deadline.

Don't Have the UIDAI Certificate Yet? Here's What to Do Right Now

If you meet the educational and age eligibility but haven't yet obtained the mandatory UIDAI Aadhaar Operator or Supervisor certificate, you still have time before July 20, 2026 - but you need to act immediately.

Step 1 – Register for the Exam:
Visit https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and register for the Aadhaar Supervisor examination.

Step 2 – Get State Team Authorization:
After you apply for the exam, an authorization request goes to the State Team. They must approve it before you can sit the exam. This can take a few days, so apply without delay.

Step 3 – Alternatively, Try LMS Certification:
If you already have an LMS ID and password, log in at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in to attempt the LMS-based certification route.

Step 4 – Download Your Certificate:
Once you pass the exam, download your UIDAI-authorized certificate and keep it ready to submit with your CSC application.

Time is limited. The certification process involves state-level authorization that adds waiting time. Start today if you want to apply before July 20, 2026.

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility requirements differ by post for both educational qualifications and age limits. All candidates must have passed the Matriculation Examination with Marathi as one of the subjects and must be domiciled in Maharashtra State (Domicile Certificate is mandatory). 1. Trainee Junior Officer (49 Posts)

  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience in Banking field, preferably in Urban/DCC Bank as an Officer (Officer Cadre — first level where Clerk level exists, or second level where it does not).

3. Trainee Typist – Associate Grade (04 Posts)

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend & Pay Scale

All selected candidates will be engaged as Trainees for 12 months, during which a monthly stipend is paid. After successful training, candidates are placed in the Bank's regular grade with revised emoluments. Post-confirmation, a probation of 6 months follows before permanent absorption.

How to Apply for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026

The entire application process is online through the MSC Bank career portal. Physical applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates should keep their scanned documents ready before beginning registration.

Documents to scan before applying:

  • Photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, passport style, colour, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB)
  • Signature (black ink on white paper, 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB)
  • Left thumb impression (white paper, black/blue ink, 240×240 pixels, 20–50 KB)
  • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 50–100 KB)

Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

Step-by-step application process:

  1. Visit https://msc.bank.in/career and click "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Click "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent via SMS and email.
  3. Log in and fill the application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress at each step.
  4. Upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per specifications.
  5. Fill remaining application details and click "Validate Your Details" followed by "Save & Next".
  6. Preview the complete application using the "Preview Tab" and verify all entries.
  7. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after final verification.
  8. Proceed to the Payment Tab and pay the application fee online.
  9. Click "Submit" and save/print the e-Receipt and application form for future reference.

Only one application per candidate is allowed. In case of multiple applications, only the latest will be retained and earlier fees will be forfeited.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Many applicants lose their candidature due to avoidable errors during or after the application process. Review the following checklist before submitting your form.

  • Applying for multiple posts: MSC Bank allows one application per candidate. Submit only one application for the post you are most qualified for.
  • Wrong photograph format: Passport-style colour photo against a light background is required. Selfies, group photos, or blurred images will lead to rejection.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS: Signatures in block/capital letters are strictly rejected. Sign in your normal cursive style with black ink.
  • Missing Domicile Certificate: Only Maharashtra residents can apply. Ensure your Domicile Certificate is valid and ready for document verification.
  • Not checking Marathi in SSC: All posts require Marathi as a subject in Matriculation. Check your mark sheet before applying.
  • Pressing Back/Refresh during payment: After submitting payment information, do not press Back or Refresh. Wait for the server confirmation to avoid double charges.
  • Incomplete scanning of thumb impression: The left thumb impression must be properly scanned and not smudged. A blurred or partial impression can invalidate your application.
  • Not saving the e-Receipt: If an e-Receipt is not generated, the transaction may have failed. Log in again and repeat the payment process.

What Is CSEB Kerala? - Understanding the Recruitment Process

The Cooperative Service Examination Board (CSEB), Kerala, is the state body that conducts recruitment examinations for vacancies in Kerala's cooperative banks and societies. Unlike PSC (Public Service Commission) which recruits for government departments, CSEB specifically handles the cooperative sector.

The recruitment process works in two layers:

  1. CSEB conducts the written examination and prepares a ranked list of qualified candidates for each advertisement
  2. The individual cooperative bank/society conducts the interview from the shortlisted candidates and makes the final appointment

This means that after you clear the written exam, the specific bank where the vacancy exists will call you for an interview. Final appointment is made by that bank - you are an employee of the cooperative bank, not a Kerala Government employee. However, the salary scales, service conditions, and regulations are governed by the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act and rules.

Why Apply for a Kerala Cooperative Bank Job?

Many candidates overlook cooperative bank jobs while focusing only on PSC or central government posts. Here is why CSEB recruitment deserves serious consideration:

  • Stable, permanent employment governed by the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act
  • Pay scales competitive with state government Level equivalents for the same qualifications
  • Local posting - most cooperative banks post staff within the district or region, unlike state government transfers
  • Less competition than PSC exams - the candidate pool for CSEB exams is significantly smaller than for state-level PSC recruitments
  • Multiple banks in one advertisement - you can apply to multiple institutions in the same advt by paying an additional ₹50 per bank, increasing your selection chances significantly
  • Fresher-friendly - the Junior Clerk posts especially have no experience requirement

Tips for CSEB Written Exam Preparation

  • The 100-question, 100-mark written exam typically covers: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Kerala-specific awareness, Cooperative law and principles, Mathematics/Reasoning, and English/Malayalam language
  • For Secretary and Assistant Secretary posts, expect questions on cooperative management, accounting principles, banking regulations, and the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act in depth
  • For Junior Clerk posts, the pattern is closer to a standard clerical aptitude test - reasoning, basic arithmetic, language comprehension
  • For System Administrator, expect technical questions on networking, OS administration, database management, and IT security alongside cooperative awareness
  • For DEO, expect typing/computer knowledge components alongside the written test
  • The minimum qualifying score is low (4/20 for interview eligibility) but the real competition is in clearing the cutoff that gets you called for an interview - typically much higher in popular banks. Focus on scoring in the top tier rather than just qualifying.

Can You Apply for Multiple Banks in the Same Advertisement?

Yes - and this is a significant strategic advantage. Unlike most government recruitment processes where you apply to one organization, the CSEB system allows a single candidate to apply to multiple cooperative banks under the same advertisement number. Each additional bank beyond the first requires an extra ₹50 exam fee.

For example, under Advt. 17/2026 (Junior Clerk – Super Grade), if you want to be considered for 3 banks, you pay: ₹150 (first bank) + ₹50 + ₹50 = ₹250 (+ 18% GST).

This is particularly useful for candidates who are flexible about work location within Kerala, as it dramatically increases the number of vacancies you are effectively competing for.

Sourced from official CSEB Kerala notifications Advt. No. 15/2026 to 21/2026, issued by the Cooperative Service Examination Board, Thiruvananthapuram, dated May 30, 2026.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

All eligibility conditions are assessed as on the respective cut-off dates stated above. Candidates must independently verify they meet every criterion before applying; merely submitting an application does not constitute a right to be called for selection.

Educational Qualification and Work Experience

Post 3 - Senior Manager, Cloud Centre of Excellence (MMGS III) Same mandatory degree requirement as Post 1. Preferred certifications: AWS Solutions Architect (Professional), Azure Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Google Associate/Professional Cloud Engineer.

Preferred certifications: AWS Solutions Architect (Professional), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable. Payment must be made online only - cash, cheques, money orders, and postal stamps are not accepted. Bank transaction charges for the online payment gateway are borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee
SC / ST / PwBD ₹100 + applicable taxes + payment gateway charges
General, EWS & OBC ₹850 + applicable taxes + payment gateway charges

Once submitted, an application cannot be withdrawn, and the fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor held in reserve for any other examination.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The bank will use a multi-stage selection process for all posts. All three scales - SMGS IV, MMGS III, and MMGS II - follow the same procedure: Written Test → Short-listing → Personal Interview.

The written test, where conducted, will have the following structure:

Section Questions Maximum Marks Duration
English Language 20 20 15 minutes
General Awareness 20 20 30 minutes
Professional Knowledge 60 60 60 minutes
Total 100 100 105 minutes

The minimum qualifying score in each section is 40% for General and EWS candidates and 35% for Reserved Category candidates. However, only Professional Knowledge marks are used for drawing the merit/rank list and shortlisting candidates for the Personal Interview; marks in English Language and General Awareness are not included in the final merit calculation.

Candidates clearing the written test are called for a Personal Interview. The minimum qualifying score for the interview is 40% for Unreserved and EWS candidates and 35% for Reserved categories. Final selection is based on the combined marks from the written test and Personal Interview, in order of merit ranking. Where two candidates tie at the cut-off, they are ranked in descending order of age.

The Personal Interview will be conducted in New Delhi unless otherwise specified. Call letters will be sent by email only. Candidates must attend at their own cost.

The bank shortlists candidates based on experience and suitability at its own discretion - meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee an interview call.

Examination Centres

The bank has designated examination centres across India. Candidates may opt for a centre in their state, subject to availability. The bank reserves the right to allot a different centre or cancel/add centres. No request for a change of examination centre, date, or session will be entertained. Selected centres include: Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), Guwahati (Assam), Patna and Bhagalpur (Bihar), Chandigarh/Mohali, Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Delhi/Delhi-NCR, Panaji (Goa), Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar (Gujarat), Ambala (Haryana), Hamirpur (Himachal Pradesh), Jammu (J&K), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Ernakulam (Kerala), Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh), Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai/MMR (Maharashtra), Bhubaneswar (Odisha), Patiala (Punjab), Jaipur (Rajasthan), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Hyderabad (Telangana), Prayagraj, Lucknow and Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), Dehradun (Uttarakhand), and Asansol and Siliguri (West Bengal), among others.

Terms of Contract

This engagement is on a contractual basis, not a regular/permanent appointment. The initial period is three years, subject to annual performance review. Depending on need and performance, the bank may extend the contract on an annual basis for up to a maximum of two additional years at its discretion.

The bank may terminate the contract at any time without assigning any reason by giving one month's notice or paying one month's fixed component of compensation in lieu. Similarly, the appointee must give the bank one month's clear notice - or equivalent payment - to exit the contract before its expiry.

Additional conditions: the selected individual must not take up any assignment with any other organization during the contract period; no vigilance case or adverse observation from previous employers should be pending; and the candidate must have a minimum CIBIL score of 650 at the time of joining.

How to Apply

Applications are accepted online only through the bank's official website. The steps below reflect the application flow described in the notification.

  1. Visit https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and navigate to the Recruitment section on the home page.
  2. Click on the relevant notification for Cloud CoE / AI Engineers.
  3. Before starting registration, scan and prepare the following files:
    • Passport-size photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG/PNG)
    • Signature on white paper in black ink (10–20 KB)
    • Left thumb impression on white paper (20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG)
    • Hand-written declaration in English, on white paper in black ink - text: "I, [Name], hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." (50–100 KB; JPG/JPEG; NOT in capital letters)
    • Supporting documents in PDF format: Brief Resume, ID Proof, Age Proof, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates/NOC, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  4. Complete the online registration form. Keep the registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the process.
  5. Upload all documents at the specified fields. The system will not proceed until photographs and signatures meet specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate.
  7. Submit the application and save/print the system-generated application form with the registration number.
  8. Apply separately for each post if applying for more than one position.

In case of multiple submissions for the same post, only the last valid completed application will be retained; fees paid for earlier submissions will be forfeited.

Documents Required at Document Verification

Candidates called for the interview stage must bring originals and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents. Documents not produced on the day of verification will disqualify the candidate from further participation.

Required documents include: Date of Birth proof (SSC/School Leaving Certificate); printout of call letter; system-generated online application printout; all educational certificates and mark sheets from Class X onwards (semester-wise mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate); all work experience certificates and NOC from the current employer if employed with a public sector bank or government/quasi-government organization; caste/category certificates in the prescribed Government of India format (OBC certificate must be no more than one year old and contain the non-creamy layer clause); disability certificate from District Medical Board (if applicable); Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates, valid as on the date of application); two passport-size photographs identical to the one in the application; and valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, Employee ID, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted).

No documents should be sent directly to the bank before or after the interview.

Troubleshooting & Common Mistakes

Photo/Signature upload errors are among the most common reasons for application failure. Ensure your photograph is between 20 KB and 50 KB and your signature between 10 KB and 20 KB. Files larger than the specified limit will be rejected by the system. Use a scanner set to at least 200 DPI and save files in JPG/JPEG format. All supporting documents must be in PDF format.

Payment gateway failures can occur during high-traffic periods near the deadline. If a payment is deducted but the fee status is not updated, wait 24 hours and check again before attempting re-payment; duplicate payments are generally not refunded. Avoid applying on the last day to reduce the risk of server overload.

Hand-written declaration errors are a unique pitfall in this recruitment. The declaration must be in English, in the candidate's own handwriting, in lowercase (not capital letters). A typed or third-party-written declaration will invalidate the application.

Name mismatches between the application and identity documents can cause disqualification at any stage. Ensure the name (and father's/husband's name where applicable) is spelled exactly as it appears on your certificates and mark sheets. Candidates who have changed their name must produce an original Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or affidavit.

CIBIL score is a condition of joining, not selection. Candidates are advised to check their CIBIL score before applying - a score below 650 will disqualify them at the time of joining even if selected.

Who should NOT apply for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have not passed the JAIIB examination (for Specialized Branch Manager) or the CAIIB examination (for Manager – Contract) — these are hard mandatory requirements.
  • Candidates without at least 5 years of experience as a Branch Manager at Officer level in a commercial/co-op bank (for Specialized Branch Manager).
  • Candidates without at least 10–12 years of experience at Senior/Middle Management level in a commercial/co-op bank (for Manager – Contract).
  • Candidates who are not domiciled in Maharashtra State — Maharashtra domicile certificate is compulsory for both posts; non-Maharashtra residents cannot apply.
  • Candidates who are below 45 years of age as on 01-05-2026 — both posts have a minimum age of 45 years.
  • Candidates for Manager (Contract) who are above 62 years of age as on 01-05-2026.
  • Candidates unwilling to be posted/transferred anywhere in Maharashtra — all services are liable to be transferred.
  • Candidates for Specialized Branch Manager who are unwilling to execute the 5-year service bond and pay Rs. 10 Lakh as liquidated damages in case of early exit.
  • Government/PSU/Bank employees who have not informed their employer in writing about applying for this recruitment — submission of employer information copy is a mandatory requirement.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not downloading both Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form) from https://msc.bank.in/career — both must be filled and submitted together.
  • Not enclosing the Maharashtra Domicile Certificate with the application — applications without it will be treated as ineligible.
  • Not enclosing self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents (educational certificates, JAIIB/CAIIB certificate, experience certificates, date of birth proof) — applications without mandatory enclosures will not be considered.
  • Candidates currently in Government/PSU/Bank service not enclosing a copy of their employer intimation letter (informing their Head of Office/Department about the application) — this is a mandatory requirement.
  • Super-scribing the envelope incorrectly — the envelope must be clearly super-scribed as "Application for the post of Specialized Branch Managers" (Advt. 01) or "Application for the post of Managers (Contract)" (Advt. 02) respectively.
  • Applying for both posts in a single envelope or under a single application — each post requires a separate application as per respective advertisement instructions.
  • Not providing a definite timeline/proof for relieving from the current employer if selected — this must be mentioned with documentary proof in the application.
  • Not providing references of two important professionals/Government officials as required in the application form.

How to Apply for MSC Bank Specialized Branch Manager & Manager (Contract) Recruitment 2026-27

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply

Candidates must apply Online only through the Bank's official website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before filling the application, candidates must mandatorily read the notification and instructions carefully.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

Step 1: Visit the Bank's official website https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in and open the link "BDCC RECRUITMENT 2026" on a desktop/laptop computer. Read the notification and instructions carefully before filling the application.

  • After clicking the registration box, a confirmation check box will appear for candidates who have previously applied and paid the fee. Those candidates must re-submit the application with the same registration number clearly mentioned, upload documents, and re-submit.
  • A check box will appear: "Are you re-applying after already submitting an application and fee payment?" If Yes, mention the previous application registration number clearly, upload documents, and re-submit the application.

Step 2: Visit http://www.bellarydcc.bank.in, register and log in. Enter your SSLC marks, name, date of birth, disability status, and other required details. Verify mobile number and email ID via OTP. Register successfully.

  • Candidates who previously applied and downloaded the application under the earlier notification must register again with a new registration number and re-upload documents per the new requirements. Fee once paid for the earlier application is not refunded, and no separate fee is required again for that post.

Step 3: Use your registration number and date of birth as login credentials. Review and edit all details and qualification information if needed. Preview the application carefully before confirming. Once submitted, no information can be changed.

Step 4: Upload Photo and Signature. The candidate must upload their passport-size photograph on a blank white paper with signature below using a black Sketch/Marker pen; scan and upload. Applications without photo/signature or incomplete applications will be rejected.

  • After uploading photo and signature, upload all required SSLC marks/reservation-related documents with self-attestation, then submit.

Step 5: After submitting, pay the application fee and applicable gateway charges through the Payment Gateway link.

  • DPI Setting: 100 DPI
  • Quality: 100%
  • Color: Color
  • Format: JPG/JPEG
  • Photo size: 35mm × 45mm; Signature below: 35mm × 20mm

They must clearly mention the previous registration number and re-upload all required documents. No separate fee payment is required for those posts.

Once Application Re-submit is done, it cannot be re-edited and fees paid will not be refunded. Each post still requires a separate application; one Application Re-submit per post is allowed.

Caste Reservation Certificate Requirements

For candidates claiming reservation benefits:

  • SC (Category A, B, C) / ST / Pangada candidates: Upload certificate in Form-D
  • Category-1 candidates: Upload certificate in Form-E
  • Category-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates: Upload certificate in Form-F, obtained from the concerned Tahsildar; these certificates for Backward Hindu categories must be valid within 5 years from the date of application.

Rural Candidate Reservation:

  • Rural candidates must have studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a village (rural area) under the current rules; certificate must be current and valid.
  • SC/ST/Pangada candidates claiming Rural reservation must submit Form-2 rural reservation certificate.
  • General category candidates claiming rural reservation must submit Form-1 rural certificate along with proof that they are not otherwise listed as urban.
  • General category, SC/ST/Pangada, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates who fail to submit the required rural reservation certificate will be treated as ineligible for rural reservation.
  • Note: Certificate in Form-2 must be obtained from the Headmaster of the school where the candidate studied and attested by the concerned field education officer.

Kannada Medium Candidates:

  • Candidates claiming Kannada Medium reservation must submit a certificate from the Headmaster of the school where they studied Kannada medium along with date of school's issue, signed certificate, and must be held valid as on the last date of application. Original copies must be produced at verification. If not produced, the Kannada Medium reservation will be cancelled.

Scheme-Deprived (Yojane Nirashritha) Candidates:

  • Must produce a certificate from the concerned Tahsildar in the prescribed format as per current rules. Certificate must be valid up to the last date of application and must be current.

Ex-Servicemen:

  • Ex-Serviceman means a person who has served in any rank (combatant or non-combatant) in the Central Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) - excluding persons who served in Defence Security Corps, General Reserve Engineering Force, Lok Sahayak Sena, and Para-Military Forces.
  • Family members (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) of persons who died while serving in Central Armed Forces are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation; however, age relaxation will not be provided to them.
  • Eligible cases for Ex-Servicemen reservation:
    • Retired voluntarily from such service after receiving pension; OR
    • Released from military service on medical grounds with medical and physical disability pension; OR
    • Released from service due to reduction of personnel; OR
    • Released from service after completing specific service and receiving gratuity, after fulfilling period of service - including: persons retired from continuous service, persons with physical disability due to military service, and gazette prize winners.
  • Persons currently re-employed in government service after retiring from military service must apply for military reservation through their current service NOC before appointment; they are allowed to enjoy all benefits available to ex-servicemen during re-employment, but the bank will not be responsible if they are not matched with the post. They must submit their discharge certificate before applying.
  • Ex-servicemen applicants, persons dependent on ex-servicemen who were killed or permanently disabled while in service - (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) - are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation benefits. Age relaxation will not be provided to dependents. They must submit the discharge certificate and permanence/gratuity certificate; at the time of original document verification, original copies must be produced.

Differently-Abled (Physically Challenged) Candidates:

  • Only candidates with a minimum of 40% benchmark disability certified by the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format (NOT in any other format) are eligible for differently-abled reservation. Certificate must be issued in the prescribed Government notification format.
  • Differently-Abled candidates who require a scribe for the written examination must upload a special medical certificate from the Medical Board stating that they are unable to write due to physical disability.
  • The scribe requirement must be indicated at the time of application in the specified field in the online application; only when required, the candidate may request a scribe from the examination centre authority.

Who Should NOT Apply for Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the prescribed educational qualifications (degree for Manager/FDA; Second PUC for SDA; SSLC for Driver and Junior Servant) as on the last date of application.

  • Candidates who cannot read, write, speak, and understand Kannada - knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all posts.
  • Candidates below 18 years of age or above the maximum age limit applicable to their category.
  • OBC (Category-2A/2B/3A/3B) Creamy Layer candidates applying under reserved categories - only non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • Candidates with less than 40% disability who apply for Differently-Abled reservation - only 40%+ benchmark disability qualifies.
  • Vehicle Driver candidates who do not hold a valid legal driving license.
  • Candidates currently employed in any organization who cannot produce an NOC from their employer.
  • Candidates who obtained degrees or certificates from institutions declared fake or derecognized by competent educational authorities - such applications will be rejected at any stage.
  • Candidates who provide false information or suppress facts - such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution and disqualification at any stage of the selection process.
  • Persons who are members of or active in any banned organization, or who have attempted to overthrow the Government of India, or who have been convicted under any law, or who have taken part in activities against the sovereignty or integrity of India, or who have been dismissed from any government service.
  • Candidates with mental illness or mental disability.
  • A male candidate who has more than one living wife, and a woman candidate who has married a man who already has another living wife, are not eligible.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for the wrong post for which you do not meet the educational qualification.

  • Selecting the wrong category (General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) - categories cannot be changed after submission; mismatched certificates lead to cancellation.
  • OBC (Backward Hindu 2A/2B/3A/3B) candidates from Creamy Layer applying under OBC reservation instead of General category.
  • Not uploading all mandatory documents at the time of online application - incomplete applications will be rejected outright.
  • Uploading blurred, illegible, or incorrect photographs, signatures, or certificates - leading to rejection at document verification stage.
  • Using an inactive or wrong mobile number and email ID - exam dates, interview schedules, and admit cards are communicated only through SMS and email.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post without following the proper Re-submit process - only the last valid application is considered and fees for others are forfeited.
  • Not reading the separate instructions for candidates who applied under the earlier notification (06.04.2026) - they must re-apply with their old registration number and need not pay fee again for the same post.
  • Not noting that each post requires a separate application and separate fee - applying for multiple posts with a single application/fee is not permitted.
  • Paying the fee through DD/Postal Order/Money Order or any offline mode - only online payment (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/Google Pay) is accepted.
  • Not keeping originals of all uploaded documents ready for verification - originals must be produced at the time of interview/verification.
  • Ignoring the minimum qualifying mark requirement: candidates must score a minimum of 85 out of 100 (or 200) in the written examination to qualify for the interview.

Important Instructions for Bellary DCC Bank  Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Applications must be submitted Online only at https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in; no other mode is accepted.

  • Candidates must mandatorily keep Kannada language proficiency - it is essential for all posts.
  • Information provided by candidates at the time of application regarding category, date of birth, educational qualification, age relaxation, etc., can only be for consideration purposes and will not be changed later; no request for change will be entertained afterward.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without photo/signature, or applications with incorrect information will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must self-attest all documents and mandatorily upload them online.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of the submitted application for their own reference.
  • Admit cards for the written examination and date/venue/time of interview will be communicated via SMS, email, or the Bank's website; admit cards will NOT be sent by post.
  • The Bank/external body reserves the right to advance, postpone, cancel, and change the rules of the recruitment process at any time without giving any reason.
  • The decision of the Bank's Board/Staff Recruitment Committee shall be final in all matters relating to recruitment; no correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates must serve a probation period of 2 years after selection.
  • Selected candidates will be provided security deposit and personal bond as informed by the Bank; they must sign a contract and pay the prescribed security deposit on joining.
  • This recruitment is subject to directions and orders of the Karnataka Government / High Court during the recruitment notification period.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • No correspondence regarding recruitment will be entertained from any candidate after the process has concluded.

Selection Process: How Candidates Will Be Chosen

Selection for these IT Specialized Officer posts is interview-based, with no written examination stage. After the interview, shortlisted candidates go through a multi-step verification process before receiving a final appointment.

  1. Eligibility Screening – Applications are scrutinized against the post-specific eligibility criteria; only eligible candidates are shortlisted.
  2. Interview – Shortlisted candidates appear for a direct interview for the specific post they applied for.
  3. Preliminary Offer Letter – Issued to candidates who qualify in the interview.
  4. Verification Stage – Candidates undergo Background Verification, Police Verification, Medical Examination, and Documentation.
  5. Final Offer Letter – Issued once all verification steps are successfully completed.
  6. Probation Period – Selected candidates serve a 6-month probation, after which they are confirmed in their respective post.

The notification does not specify exact timelines between these stages; the interview date will be communicated directly to eligible candidates after screening.

Documents and Service Bond Requirements

Beyond the application form itself, candidates need to prepare supporting documents and understand the service commitment attached to this recruitment. This is an area where incomplete submissions commonly lead to rejection.

  • Self-attested photocopies of all relevant qualification and experience certificates must be enclosed with the application.
  • A domicile certificate of Maharashtra State is compulsory, since only Maharashtra residents are eligible to apply.
  • A recent passport-size photograph must be affixed (not pinned or stapled) to Annexure-1.
  • Selected candidates must execute an undertaking on ₹500 stamp paper committing to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Breach of this undertaking requires payment of ₹10 lakh as liquidated damages upon demand, along with two surety bonds of ₹1 lakh each from two income-tax-paying sureties.
  • Candidates currently employed in government departments, PSUs, banks, or financial institutions must inform their employer in writing before applying and attach proof of this with the application.
  • At the time of joining, selected candidates must produce a proper discharge certificate from their previous employer.

How to Apply: Offline Application Process

This recruitment does not have an "Apply Online" option - every application must be physically posted to the Bank. Following the steps below in order helps avoid the most common submission errors.

  1. Visit the Bank's career page at https://msc.bank.in/career.
  2. Download Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form).
  3. Fill in all details completely and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
  4. Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant qualification and experience certificates.
  5. Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the post of [post name]."
  6. Send the sealed application via Post / Speed Post / Courier to:
    The Deputy General Manager (O.S.D.), HRD&M Department, The Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd., Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, 9, Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce Lane, Fort, Mumbai – 400001, Post Box No. 472.
  7. Ensure the application physically reaches the Bank on or before 08.07.2026, up to 5:15 PM - postmark dates are not mentioned as sufficient.

Candidates can apply for only one post, so the post name should be decided before filling the form.

Special Eligibility Rules for Existing MSC Bank Employees

Current MSC Bank staff interested in these posts face a different set of conditions than external applicants, which is worth knowing before applying internally.

  • Applicants must first obtain written permission from the Bank, including prior approval of the Managing Director routed through their Department Incharge and the HRDM Manager.
  • Confirmed employees who meet all eligibility criteria can apply but are not entitled to any concession.
  • Official leave must be taken to attend the interview.
  • If selected in the immediate senior grade, salary is fixed as per prevailing practice based on regular service, excluding any Special Workload Allowance from the previous grade.
  • Employees applying for a post above their immediate seniority must resign from their current role after selection, following standard resignation rules.
  • Instead of the 5-year bond, internally selected employees execute an undertaking on ₹500 stamp paper to serve the Bank until retirement or superannuation.

Common Mistakes to Avoid When Applying

These are practical pitfalls based on how this recruitment is structured, meant to help candidates submit a clean application the first time.

  • Assuming this recruitment has an online portal - it is offline only, and any "apply online" claim for this advertisement should be treated with caution.
  • Forgetting to attach the Maharashtra domicile certificate, which is compulsory, not optional documentation.
  • Pinning or stapling the photograph on Annexure-1 instead of simply affixing it as instructed.
  • Applying for more than one post, since only single-post applications are accepted.
  • Sending unattested photocopies instead of self-attested ones.
  • Failing to inform a current government, PSU, or bank employer in writing before submitting the application.
  • Overlooking the one-year window to acquire a mandatory certification when it isn't already held.
  • Posting the application close to the deadline without accounting for postal transit time - the form must reach the Bank by 5:15 PM on 08.07.2026, not just be sent by that date.

PDC Bank Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 is built on two pillars - educational qualification and relevant banking experience - and both vary by post. The details below help candidates check which post they qualify for before applying.

Educational Qualification

A graduate degree from a recognised university is the essential minimum requirement for every post in this recruitment; higher qualifications and professional certifications are preferred for managerial roles.

Post Name Educational Qualification
General Manager / Deputy General Manager / Assistant General Manager Essential: Graduate in any subject from a recognised university. Preferred: M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA, CMA, or equivalent.
Manager / Deputy Manager / Executive / Senior Officer / Junior Officer Essential: Graduate in any subject from a recognised university. Post-graduation degree is desirable.
Clerk Graduate in any subject from a recognised university with a minimum of 55% marks.

Candidates without a computer background must hold a Basic Computer Course certificate, or complete the relevant course within six months of joining the bank, to remain eligible for appointment.

Importantly, the notification specifies that all educational qualifications must be completed within the minimum course duration declared by the respective university or board. Candidates who took extra semesters or years to clear a backlog or ATKT are not eligible to apply for any of these posts.

Experience Required

Relevant prior experience in a cooperative or commercial bank is mandatory for all posts except Clerk. The table below summarises the minimum experience needed for each post.

Post Name Minimum Experience Required (in Cooperative/Commercial Banks)
General Manager 8+ years as Manager or equivalent
Deputy General Manager 5+ years as Manager or equivalent
Assistant General Manager 5+ years as Assistant Manager, Senior Officer, or equivalent
Manager 3+ years as Senior Officer/Assistant Manager or equivalent
Deputy Manager 3+ years as Senior Officer/Assistant Manager or equivalent
Executive 3+ years as Senior Officer/Assistant Manager or equivalent
Senior Officer 3+ years as Junior Officer or equivalent
Junior Officer 3+ years as Clerk/Cashier/Front Line Staff or equivalent
Clerk Not required

PDC Bank Age Limit 2026

Age limits for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 differ widely by post, reflecting the seniority of each role, and will be calculated as on 1 July 2026.

Post Name Age Limit (as on 01.07.2026)
General Manager 35 - 51 years*
Deputy General Manager 32 - 45 years*
Assistant General Manager 30 - 40 years*
Manager 28 - 40 years*
Deputy Manager 28 - 40 years*
Executive 28 - 40 years*
Senior Officer 25 - 35 years*
Junior Officer 22 - 32 years*
Clerk 20 - 30 years (no age relaxation)

*Age relaxation in the upper age limit applies only as an exception for exceptionally capable and experienced candidates. There is no relaxation in the minimum age requirement for any post.

Also Read: Bank of Baroda C&IC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out

PDC Bank Application Fee 2026

This section covers exactly how much candidates need to pay and how the fee should be submitted while applying for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026.

  • Application fee is ₹1000/- per post for all categories of candidates.
  • The fee must be paid online through UPI QR Code on the application portal.
  • The fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Candidates must save the fee payment confirmation/receipt for future reference.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must pay the fee separately for each post applied to.

PDC Bank Selection Process 2026

Selection for all posts under PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 follows a two-stage process, with candidates applying to multiple posts required to clear a separate exam for each.

  • Written Examination for candidates who meet the eligibility criteria.
  • Interview for candidates shortlisted from the written examination.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post will be required to appear for a separate written examination for each post.
  • Final selection is based on combined performance in the written examination and interview, as per the bank's discretion.

PDC Bank Recruitment 2026: Competition Level Analysis

Competition for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 will vary sharply by post, mainly due to the difference in vacancy count and the experience criteria attached to each role.

The Clerk post, with 100 vacancies and no prior experience requirement, is open to all fresh graduates meeting the 55% marks criterion and is expected to draw the highest volume of applications among all nine posts. The Junior Officer post, with 30 vacancies, also has a wide vacancy spread but is restricted to candidates with at least 3 years of relevant front-line banking experience, which narrows the applicant pool compared to Clerk. At the other end, posts such as General Manager (1 vacancy), Assistant General Manager (2), and Manager (2) demand 3 to 8+ years of managerial-level cooperative or commercial banking experience, which limits the eligible pool to seasoned banking professionals - even though the absolute number of applicants will be lower, competition per seat remains intense given how few vacancies are available at the senior level.

Who Should NOT Apply for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026

Based strictly on the eligibility conditions in the notification, candidates falling into the following categories should not apply, as their applications are likely to be rejected:

  • Candidates who do not meet the minimum or maximum age limit specified for the post as on 1 July 2026, particularly Clerk applicants outside the 20-30 year range, since no age relaxation applies to this post.
  • Candidates who completed their graduation or post-graduation by taking extra semesters or years beyond the minimum duration declared by their university/board to clear a backlog or ATKT - the notification explicitly excludes such candidates.
  • Candidates who do not hold the minimum years of relevant cooperative/commercial banking experience required for the specific post (for example, applying for Deputy General Manager without 5+ years of managerial experience).
  • Candidates who do not have, and cannot arrange, online payment facilities such as UPI, since only online fee payment is accepted.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

Many otherwise eligible candidates risk rejection or loss of the non-refundable fee due to avoidable errors. Keep these points in mind before submitting the application:

  • Sending a hard copy or offline application - the bank will accept only online applications for every post.
  • Not saving the UPI payment confirmation/receipt after paying the application fee, which the notification specifically asks candidates to retain.
  • Calculating age based on the application date instead of the official cut-off date of 1 July 2026.
  • Assuming one written exam covers multiple post applications - each post applied for requires a separate written examination.
  • For Clerk applicants from a non-computer background, forgetting to arrange the Basic Computer Course certificate within six months of joining.
  • Paying the non-refundable fee before carefully checking the age and experience criteria for the chosen post.

How to Apply for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026

The application process for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Follow these steps to submit your application correctly:

  1. Visit the official career portal at https://pdc.bank.in/career or the application portal at https://pdc.ugrowhrservices.com.
  2. Read the official notification carefully and identify the post(s) you are eligible for.
  3. Fill in the digital application form with accurate personal, educational and experience details.
  4. Upload all required documents as specified in the notification.
  5. Pay the application fee of ₹1000/- per post using the UPI QR Code provided on the portal.
  6. Save and download the fee payment confirmation for future reference.
  7. Submit the application before the deadline of 28 June 2026 and keep a copy/screenshot of the submitted form.

Eligible candidates can submit their application directly through the official application portal before the closing date.

Apply Online for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 through the official portal at https://pdc.ugrowhrservices.com, or visit https://pdc.bank.in/career for the career page.

Important Instructions for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following official conditions in mind before and after applying:

  • The probation period for all cadres is 1 year from the date of joining the bank, and may be extended if required.
  • All correspondence regarding examinations and interviews will be sent only through email - no other mode of communication will be used.
  • Candidates must bear their own travel and boarding expenses to attend the written examination and interview venue.
  • The bank reserves all rights related to the recruitment process without being required to give any reason.
  • The bank has an unrestricted right to extend the last date for submission of applications.
