The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) have opened a special CCAA Modification Window 2026 for candidates under CEN No. 08/2024, popularly known as RRB Group D recruitment. The window is open from 17 June 2026 (00:01 hrs) to 23 June 2026 (23:59 hrs), allowing eligible Course Completed Act Apprentice (CCAA) candidates who appeared in the CBT but had not entered their NCVT examination marks to update this information online before the deadline closes.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This is a one-time, time-bound opportunity. If you are a CCAA candidate and missed filling in your NCVT marks at the time of applying, this article explains exactly who can use this window, what you need to update, the step-by-step process, and what happens if you miss the deadline.

Click Here: RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026

RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026 - Key Highlights

This section gives a quick snapshot of the most important facts about the modification window the recruitment body, notification number, opening and closing dates, and who it applies to so you can confirm at a glance whether this update concerns you.

Detail Information
Recruitment Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB)
Notification Number CEN No. 08/2024 (Level-1 / Group D)
Total Vacancies (CEN 08/2024) 32,438
Window Opens 17 June 2026, 00:01 hrs
Window Closes 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs
Eligible Candidates CCAA candidates who appeared in CBT but did not furnish NCVT marks
Official Notice Date 16 June 2026
Purpose Updating NCVT certificate details and marks for CCAA quota benefits

Who Are CCAAs and Why Does This Update Matter?

Before looking at eligibility and steps, it helps to understand who qualifies as a CCAA and why updating NCVT details carries real weight in the RRB Group D selection process.

Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAAs) are candidates who have completed their apprenticeship training in a Railway Establishment under the Apprentices Act. CCAAs trained in a Railway Establishment receive two specific advantages over general candidates in the RRB Group D selection process:

  • NCVT marks weightage: Marks obtained in the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) examination are given due weightage while preparing the final merit list after the CBT.
  • PET exemption: CCAAs trained in Railway Establishments are fully exempt from the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which is mandatory for all other Group D candidates.

Because these two benefits directly affect a candidate's final merit position and exam process, any CCAA candidate who has not yet recorded their NCVT marks needs to act within this window to remain eligible for them.

Why Was the CCAA Modification Window Opened?

This section explains the background that led RRB to open this window, helping candidates understand whether their specific situation matches the criteria.

The matter traces back to an earlier notice dated 3 February 2025, which addressed two categories of CCAA applicants:

  • Category 1: CCAAs who had already received their National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT at the time of application were instructed to enter their training duration, certificate details, and marks directly in the online form.
  • Category 2: CCAAs who had appeared for the NCVT examination before the application deadline, but whose results were not yet declared, were advised to fill in their exam date and flag the result as "awaited."

Despite this earlier instruction, a number of eligible CCAA candidates who went on to appear in the CBT still had not entered their NCVT marks in the system. To allow these candidates to claim the benefits they are entitled to under the CCAA quota, RRB has now opened this dedicated modification window from 17 to 23 June 2026.

Who Is Eligible for the RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026?

This section lists the exact eligibility conditions, since only candidates meeting all three criteria together can use this facility.

A candidate can use this modification window only if all three of the following conditions are met:

  1. The candidate appeared in the Computer Based Test (CBT) under CEN No. 08/2024.
  2. The candidate had not entered their NCVT examination marks in the original online application.
  3. The candidate had indicated the date of their NCVT examination in the application, typically with a "results awaited" flag.

If even one of these conditions is not met for instance, if you did not appear in the CBT, or if your NCVT marks were already filled in correctly at the time of application you are not eligible to use this window.

What Can Be Updated in the Modification Window?

This part covers exactly what information eligible candidates are permitted to add or change during the 17–23 June window.

During this window, eligible CCAA candidates can:

  • Fill in NCVT certificate details, if not entered earlier
  • Update the marks obtained in the NCVT examination
  • Enter National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) details

Once submitted, RRB uses this information to calculate the applicable NCVT weightage for the candidate's CCAA quota benefit, which then feeds into the preparation of the final merit list.

How to Update NCVT Details: Step-by-Step Process

This section walks through the practical process of making the update, from logging in to final submission.

  1. Visit the official RRB website for your respective zone, or the centralised application portal as indicated in your candidature.
  2. Log in to your CEN 08/2024 application using your registration number and password/date of birth.
  3. Navigate to the "Modification Window" or "CCAA/NCVT Details Update" section.
  4. Enter your NCVT certificate number, marks obtained, date of examination, training duration, and any other requested details.
  5. Upload supporting documents if the system prompts you to do so.
  6. Carefully review every entry before submission, since corrections cannot be made once the window closes.
  7. Submit the form before 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs, and save or download the confirmation/screenshot for your records.

Always complete this process only through the official RRB website for your zone or the application portal linked in the official notice. Avoid third-party websites claiming to offer "application update services," as these are not authorised by RRB.

What Happens If You Miss the Modification Window?

This section explains the consequences of not updating NCVT details within the given time frame, which is critical information for any eligible candidate still undecided about acting.

Missing this window has direct consequences for a CCAA candidate's selection prospects. If you do not update your certificate details and marks during the 17–23 June period, you will not be treated as a "CCAA Trained in Railway Establishment possessing NAC granted by NCVT." As a result, you will:

  • Lose the NCVT marks weightage benefit in the final merit list
  • Not be considered under the CCAA quota for this benefit
  • Likely be required to appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which CCAA candidates would otherwise be exempt from

Given how competitive RRB Group D recruitment is, losing either of these advantages can materially affect your final selection chances. There is no indication of any extension beyond 23 June 2026, so candidates are advised not to wait until the last day.

Will NCVT Details Be Verified Later?

This short section addresses a common follow-up concern: whether the information submitted now will be checked later in the process.

Yes. As per the official notice, all NCVT examination details filled in by candidates during this modification window will be verified at the Document Verification (DV) stage. Candidature remains subject to the accuracy of the information submitted, so candidates should ensure that certificate numbers, marks, and dates exactly match their original NAC certificate and mark sheet before final submission.

Documents to Keep Ready

Having these documents on hand before you start the update process will make the modification quicker and reduce the risk of entry errors.

  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by NCVT
  • NCVT mark sheet showing marks obtained
  • Proof of apprenticeship training duration
  • Railway Establishment training-related documents

Is RRB Group D Exam 2026 Postponed?

Many candidates are concerned about a possible postponement of the RRB Group D exam based on the previous experience with CEN 08/2024, where the exam was rescheduled multiple times due to court cases, normalization controversies, and administrative reasons.

However, candidates should note that such delays are not a regular occurrence with every recruitment cycle. Currently, there is no official notice or announcement about any postponement of the CEN 09/2025 CBT 1 examination. Candidates are advised to:

  • Continue their preparation without interruption.
  • Regularly check the official RRB website for any updates.
  • Avoid relying on unverified social media sources for exam date information.

Stay calm and focus on building a strong preparation strategy rather than worrying about possible delays.

RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

The City Intimation Slip is a pre-exam document that informs candidates about their allotted exam city and examination centre. This is different from the Admit Card and is released earlier to help candidates make travel and accommodation arrangements in advance.

Key facts about the RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026:

  • It will be released at least 10 days before the scheduled CBT 1 exam date.
  • Candidates can download it from the official regional RRB websites.
  • Login credentials required: Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  • The slip mentions the allotted exam city (not the exact centre address - that is on the admit card).

Candidates are strongly advised to download and check the city intimation slip as soon as it is released so they can plan their travel accordingly.

RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 - Hall Ticket Details

The RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 (Hall Ticket) for CEN 09/2025 CBT 1 will be released on the official RRB regional websites a few days before the exam. Candidates need to download and carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination hall.

The RRB Group D Hall Ticket 2026 will contain:

  • Candidate's name and photograph
  • Registration number and roll number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam centre name and address
  • Important exam day instructions

Important: Candidates must carry a valid government-issued photo ID proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, PAN Card, etc.) along with the admit card. Entry without a valid admit card will not be permitted.

RRB Group D Selection Process 2026

The RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 selection process involves three stages. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for final appointment:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT 1) - Online objective type exam of 90 minutes covering Mathematics, General Science, General Intelligence & Reasoning, and General Awareness.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - A qualifying round that tests the physical fitness of shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification & Medical Examination - Final stage where documents are verified and medical fitness is assessed as per Railway medical standards.

Merit lists are prepared based on CBT 1 scores, and PET is purely qualifying in nature.

RRB Group D Preparation Tips for CBT 1 2026

With the RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 approaching in August, candidates must now focus on revision, speed improvement, and managing exam-day stress. Here are proven preparation tips to maximize your score in CBT 1:

  • Revise core topics from Mathematics, General Science, Reasoning, and General Awareness daily. Focus especially on topics with high weightage in previous year papers.
  • Solve Mock Tests and Previous Year Question Papers regularly to improve time management and accuracy under exam conditions.
  • Avoid starting new topics at this late stage. Focus on strengthening weak areas within the syllabus you have already covered.
  • Prepare quick-revision notes with important formulas, science facts, current affairs, and GK points for the last-minute revision.
  • Follow a structured daily study plan that allocates time to each subject and includes regular breaks to avoid burnout.
  • Take care of your health - adequate sleep, a balanced diet, and regular light exercise will keep your mind sharp on exam day.
  • Check official RRB websites regularly for the latest announcements on exam dates, admit cards, and schedule changes.

UP Board Class 10th/12th Compartment Online Form 2026

  • Students of Class 10 (High School) and Class 12 (Intermediate) under the Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP), Prayagraj, who are dissatisfied with their marks in any subject or with their overall result for the 2026 exams, can apply for Compartment and Improvement.   • Pay the application fee through the prescribed challan.
  • Print the completed application form and the original challan.
  • Send both documents via registered post to your regional UPMSP office by the specified deadline.

Send to UPMSP UP Board 10th / 12th Compartment Form 2026

  • After completing the online application, students must send a printed copy along with the original challan through registered post to the respective regional UPMSP office by June 27, 2026
  • The UPMSP has regional offices in Meerut, Bareilly, Prayagraj, Varanasi, and Gorakhpur.

Instructions To Send UP Board 10th / 12th Compartment Online Form 2026

  • To apply, one must fill out the online application form and obtain a printed copy of the Treasury Challan.
  • It must both be sent by registered post to the board office
  • Any application received by post or courier without prior completion of the online form will be rejected by the board.
  • The deadline for sending the application and original challan copy via registered post is June 13th, 2026.

UP Police Constable Answer Key 2026 - Download Link, Objection Window & Complete Details

The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has released the Provisional Answer Key 2026 for the Constable recruitment written examination conducted on 8th, 9th, and 10th June 2026 across six shifts. Candidates who appeared for this exam can now check the shift-wise answer key, compare their responses, and raise objections within the specified deadline if they disagree with any answer.

This article covers everything candidates need to know from the answer key release details to the step-by-step objection process and important deadlines.

Click Here: UP Police Constable Provisional Answer Key 2026

UP Police Constable Answer Key 2026 - Overview

This section gives a quick snapshot of the key details related to the UP Police Constable provisional answer key, helping candidates understand the basic facts at a glance.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB)
Post Name Constable (Civil Police, PAC, Special Security Force, PAC Women, PAC Armed Police, Jail Warder, Mounted Police)

Answer Key Type Provisional Answer Key (Shift-wise)
Answer Key Release Date 20.06.2026
Objection Mode Online Only
Objection Deadline 23.06.2026

What Is the UP Police Constable Provisional Answer Key?

Before raising any objection, candidates should understand what a provisional answer key actually represents and why it matters in the selection process.

The provisional answer key is the initial set of correct answers released by UPPRPB for each shift of the Constable written exam held on 8, 9, and 10 June 2026. It allows candidates to match their OMR responses, estimate their probable scores under the marking scheme, and gives them a chance to challenge any answer they believe is incorrect before the final answer key is published.

How to Download the UP Police Constable Answer Key 2026

This section explains the simple steps candidates can follow to access and download the provisional answer key released by UPPRPB.

To check the answer key, candidates need to:

  1. Visit the official UPPRPB answer key portal link provided in the official notice.
  2. Log in using your registration number and other required credentials.
  3. Select your exam date and shift to view the corresponding question paper and answer key.
  4. Match your recorded responses with the answer key to estimate your performance.
  5. Download or save the document for future reference.

How to Raise an Objection Against the Provisional Answer Key

This section explains the official objection process set by UPPRPB for candidates who wish to challenge any answer listed in the provisional key.

Candidates who disagree with any answer in the provisional key must follow UPPRPB's prescribed objection procedure:

  • Objections must be submitted only online through the official objection portal; submissions through any other mode will not be considered.
  • Candidates must log in with their registration number and select the specific question they wish to challenge.
  • For every disputed answer, the candidate must clearly state the answer they believe is correct, along with a valid reason.
  • Supporting documentary proof should be uploaded wherever applicable to substantiate the claim.
  • An objection fee, where applicable, must be paid online per question; this fee is refunded if the objection is later found valid.
  • The last date and time to submit objections online is 23.06.2026.
  • Objections received after the deadline, or sent through offline/other modes, will not be entertained.
  • Download and retain the acknowledgement receipt after submission for future reference.

What Is the SSB Odisha CPET 2026 Final Answer Key

The CPET (Combined Post Graduate Entrance Test) is conducted by SSB Odisha for admission to various postgraduate courses. After the exam, the board first releases a provisional answer key, allowing candidates to raise objections. Once objections are reviewed, SSB Odisha releases the final answer key, which is used for actual result preparation and merit list generation. The final answer key released on 19.06.2026 is the conclusive version and supersedes the provisional key for all 39 subjects of CPET 2026.

UP GIC Lecturer Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme

Understanding the exam structure helps candidates calculate their estimated score accurately using the answer key. The UPPSC GIC Lecturer Preliminary Examination is a single objective (MCQ) paper consisting of 120 questions carrying a total of 300 marks.

Component Details
Total Questions 120
General Studies Questions 40
Optional Subject Questions 80
Marks per Correct Answer +2.5
Negative Marking per Wrong Answer −0.83 (1/3rd of 2.5)
Unattempted Questions 0 (no deduction)
Total Marks 300

How to Calculate Your Score Using UP GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026

Once you have compared your responses with the provisional answer key, you can estimate your Prelims score using the formula below. This gives you a fair idea of whether you are likely to qualify for the Mains examination.

Score Calculation Formula:

Estimated Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 2.5) − (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.83)

Example Calculation:

Suppose a candidate attempted 100 out of 120 questions, with 82 correct and 18 wrong:

  • Marks from correct answers: 82 × 2.5 = 205 marks
  • Deduction for wrong answers: 18 × 0.83 = 14.94 marks
  • Estimated Total Score = 205 − 14.94 = 190.06 marks

Note: Unattempted questions carry zero marks and do not attract any negative marking.

UP GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026: Objection Process

If a candidate believes any answer mentioned in the UPPSC GIC Lecturer provisional answer key is incorrect, they can file an objection through the official offline process. UPPSC does not accept online objections, email submissions, or objections sent through any medium other than post or hand delivery.

Important Rules for Filing Objections:

  • One separate objection form must be submitted for each disputed question
  • Objections must be supported by valid proof from recognized reference sources only NCERT/SCERT books, government-published textbooks, or standard academic references are accepted
  • Proof from Wikipedia, coaching institute materials, or private guidebooks will be automatically rejected

Step-by-Step Offline Objection Process

Step 1 - Download the Required Documents
Visit uppsc.up.nic.in and download the provisional answer key and the official objection representation form from the Notice Board section.

Step 2 - Fill the Objection Representation Form
Enter your name, roll number, exam name (UPPSC GIC Lecturer Exam 2025), your optional subject code and name, and your question booklet series (A, B, C, or D).

Step 3 - Prepare the Discrepancy Table
For each questioned answer, create a table with:

  • Serial number of objection
  • Question number as per your booklet
  • Answer given in the UPPSC provisional key
  • Answer you believe is correct
  • Reference source with book name, author, edition, and exact page number

Step 4 - Attach Self-Attested Photocopies
Attach photocopies of the relevant pages from your reference book or government publication. Each copy must be self-attested.

Step 5 - Send by Post or Hand Delivery
Place all documents in a sealed envelope and send it via Speed Post, Registered Post, or hand delivery to:

The Exam Controller
Atigopan-5 Section
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)
10 Kasturba Gandhi Marg
Prayagraj - 211018

Objection Window: The objection deadline will be notified officially by UPPSC. Candidates are advised to keep checking uppsc.up.nic.in regularly.

UPPSC GIC Lecturer 2025: Selection Process

Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Examination will be called for the subsequent stages of selection. The complete selection process consists of:

  1. Written Preliminary Examination (Objective MCQ - 300 marks)
  2. Main (Written) Examination
  3. Interview
  4. Document Verification
  5. Final Merit List Preparation

The Prelims is a screening test. Marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are not counted towards the final merit list. Only candidates who clear the Prelims cutoff are eligible for the Mains examination.

  2. Go to the "Answer Key / Model Answer" or "What's New" section on the homepage
  3. Look for the link titled "Final Answer Key – Assistant Registrar Exam"
  4. Click on the link to open the PDF (dated 16 June 2026)
  5. Download and save the file, or take a printout for future reference

You can also access the answer key directly using the link shared at the top of this article.

Provisional vs Final Answer Key: What's the Difference?

Many candidates confuse the provisional and final answer keys, so it helps to understand how the two differ in purpose and finality before checking your score.

The provisional answer key is the first version released soon after the exam, allowing candidates a window to raise objections if they believe any answer is incorrect. The final answer key, on the other hand, is released only after MPPSC's subject experts review all objections received; it incorporates any corrections found valid and is treated as conclusive for result preparation. No further objections are entertained once the final key is published.

Aspect Provisional Answer Key Final Answer Key
Release Stage Immediately after the exam After objection review
Released On 29 November 2025 16 June 2026
Open to Objections Yes No
Used for Result No Yes

MPPSC Assistant Registrar Exam Pattern (Written Exam Structure)

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates correctly match their responses against the answer key and estimate their probable score. As per the official exam plan, the Assistant Registrar selection process is based on a written examination followed by an interview.

Component Marks
Written Examination (Objective Type, OMR-based) 450
Interview 50
Total 500

The written exam is divided into two broad sections:

  • Section A: General Studies related to Madhya Pradesh (history, geography, polity, economy, and current affairs of MP)
  • Section B: Society management and administration-related topics, including relevant laws, financial management, and important Acts

The paper is objective (multiple-choice), marked on an OMR sheet, and includes negative marking for incorrect answers as per the official marking scheme.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Final Answer Key

Once you have the final answer key PDF and your response sheet (OMR copy) ready, you can estimate your probable score before the official result is declared.

  • Match each of your marked responses against the correct option given in the final answer key
  • Add the marks for every correct answer as per the official marking scheme
  • Deduct marks for incorrect answers wherever negative marking applies
  • Leave unattempted questions unscored
  • Total the result to get your estimated written exam score

Keep in mind that this is only an estimate; your official score will be confirmed by MPPSC after evaluation.

What Happens After the Final Answer Key? (Result & Selection Process)

With the final answer key now published, the next major milestone for candidates is the declaration of results based on the written examination.

  • MPPSC will use the final answer key to evaluate all candidates' OMR responses
  • The written exam result, along with category-wise cut-off marks, will be announced on the official website
  • Candidates who clear the written exam cut-off will be shortlisted for the interview round
  • Final selection for the post of Assistant Registrar will be based on combined marks from the written exam and interview
  • A selection list and detailed marks list will be published once the entire process concludes

Candidates are advised to keep checking mppsc.mp.gov.in regularly, as MPPSC announces all subsequent updates, including results and interview schedules, on the same portal.

  • Selection Mode: Written examination followed by an interview
  • Application Process: Conducted online through the official MPPSC portal

What Is the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026?

This section explains what the answer key is and why it matters for candidates who took the Graduate Level exam.

The UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 is the provisional set of correct answers released by the commission for the recruitment examination held on June 14, 2026. The exam was conducted for various graduate-level posts under Advertisement No. 70/U030/2025 and was held in a single shift from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM. After the exam concluded, UKSSSC prepared and published the answer key for all four sets of the question paper Set A, Set B, Set C, and Set D allowing candidates to verify the correctness of their responses before final results are declared.

Since the answer key is provisional, it is not the final word on correct answers. UKSSSC has clearly stated that the key may be revised based on objections raised by candidates, which is why the objection window exists before the final answer key and result are prepared.

UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF Download

This section explains where and how candidates can download the official answer key PDF.

Candidates can download the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF directly from the link below or through the official UKSSSC website. The PDF contains the provisional correct answers for all sets of the question paper.

UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF Download Answer Key

To check the answer key directly on the official portal, candidates can also visit sssc.uk.gov.in and look for the answer key link under the relevant notification section, since UKSSSC periodically updates and hosts all answer keys on its own website.

UKSSSC Graduate Level Objection Window - Important Dates

This section lists the exact dates within which candidates can raise objections against the provisional answer key.

UKSSSC has opened a limited window for candidates to challenge any answer in the provisional key that they believe is incorrect. Missing this window means the objection will not be considered, so candidates should note these dates carefully.

  • Objection Start Date: June 17, 2026
  • Last Date to Submit Objections: June 21, 2026, up to 5:00 PM
  • Objections submitted after 5:00 PM on June 21, 2026, will not be accepted under any circumstances.

UKSSSC Answer Key Objection Fee 2026

This section explains how much candidates need to pay to raise an objection and how the payment process works.

UKSSSC requires candidates to pay a fee for every question they wish to object to. This fee structure is meant to ensure that only genuine, well-supported objections are submitted to the commission.

  • Objection Fee: ₹50 per question
  • Objections, along with the applicable fee, can only be submitted through the official online objection portal provided by UKSSSC. Offline or manual submissions are not accepted.

How to Raise an Objection Against the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026

This section outlines the guidelines candidates must follow while submitting an objection, as instructed by the commission.

UKSSSC has laid out clear instructions for the objection process to maintain transparency and ensure only valid claims are reviewed. Candidates raising an objection must:

  • Submit objections only through the official online portal no other mode is accepted.
  • Attach valid supporting documents or evidence to justify each objection raised.
  • Pay the required ₹50 fee for every question being objected to.
  • Submit all objections within the prescribed deadline, i.e., by 5:00 PM on June 21, 2026.

Once the objection window closes, UKSSSC will examine all the valid objections received and accordingly prepare and publish the final answer key.

What Happens After the Objection Period Ends?

This section explains the process that follows once candidates have submitted their objections.

After June 21, 2026, UKSSSC will review every objection submitted by candidates along with the supporting evidence provided. Based on this review, the commission will finalize the answer key, making corrections wherever an objection is found valid. The final answer key forms the basis on which the Graduate Level exam results will eventually be calculated and declared.

How to Check Your Score Using the Provisional Answer Key

This section explains the basic process candidates can follow to estimate their probable result using the released answer key.

While UKSSSC has not published a separate scorecard tool, candidates can manually estimate their performance by:

  1. Downloading the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 PDF for their respective set (A, B, C, or D).
  2. Comparing their marked responses, ideally from their response sheet or memory-based recall, with the official answers in the PDF.
  3. Noting the number of correct and incorrect answers based on the answer key.
  4. Keeping track of any answers they wish to formally object to, along with proof, before the objection window closes.

Rajasthan PTET 2026 Marking Scheme and Exam Pattern

Before calculating an expected score, candidates need to understand exactly how marks are awarded across the four sections of the PTET paper. This section breaks down the question distribution, maximum marks, and the special scaled-marking rule that applies only to the Teaching Aptitude section.

The PTET 2026 exam consisted of 200 objective-type questions worth a combined 600 marks, divided equally across four sections of 50 questions each.

Section Topic Questions Maximum Marks
Section A Mental Ability 50 150
Section B Teaching Attitude & Aptitude 50 150
Section C General Awareness 50 150
Section D Language Proficiency (Hindi or English) 50 150
Total   200 600

For Sections A, C, and D, the marking is straightforward:

Answer Type Marks Awarded
Correct Answer +3
Wrong Answer 0 (no negative marking)
Unattempted 0

Section B (Teaching Attitude & Aptitude) uses a scaled marking approach instead of a simple right-or-wrong system, since some questions in this section can have more than one reasonably correct option:

Response Quality Marks Awarded
Most Appropriate Answer +3
Second Best Answer +2
Marginally Correct Answer +1
Completely Incorrect Answer 0

There is no negative marking anywhere in the PTET exam, so candidates lose nothing for an incorrect or skipped response.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the PTET Answer Key 2026

This section explains the simple formula candidates can use to estimate their probable PTET score once they've matched their responses against the answer key. Since there's no negative marking, the calculation mainly involves counting correct answers and multiplying by the marks-per-question value.

  1. Download the answer key PDF matching your booklet Set (A, B, C, or D).
  2. Go through your OMR response sheet or recall the options you marked for each question.
  3. Tally the total number of questions you answered correctly in Sections A, C, and D.
  4. For Section B, apply the scaled marking values (+3, +2, +1, or 0) based on how closely your chosen option matches the "most appropriate" answer.
  5. Add up the marks from all four sections to arrive at your estimated total score.

Formula for Sections A, C, and D: Estimated Score = Number of Correct Answers × 3

Correct Answers Marks per Question Estimated Score
120 3 360
150 3 450
180 3 540

Keep in mind that this is only a provisional estimate. Your final, official score will depend on the final answer key issued after all valid objections have been reviewed and incorporated.

How to Raise an Objection Against the PTET Answer Key 2026

This section details the complete process for challenging an answer in the provisional key, including the eligibility criteria, required documents, and the fee structure. Only candidates who actually appeared for the exam are permitted to file an objection.

If you believe any answer in the provisional key is incorrect, you can challenge it online during the objection window, which typically stays open for 3 to 4 days after the provisional key's release. Each objection must be backed by credible evidence from a recognised academic textbook personal notes, coaching material, or unverified online sources are not accepted as valid proof.

  1. Log in to the official VMOU PTET candidate portal using your application number and password.
  2. Open the "Question Objection" or "Objection Form" section for your course (2-Year or 4-Year B.Ed.).
  3. Select your booklet Set code and enter the exact question number you wish to challenge.
  4. Write a clear justification explaining why you believe the listed answer is wrong, and state the option you think is correct.
  5. Upload a scanned page from a standard textbook supporting your claim, along with the book's name, author, and edition.
  6. Pay the objection fee of ₹100 per question through net banking, debit card, or credit card.
  7. Submit the form and download the payment confirmation receipt for your records.

After the objection window closes, a subject-expert committee constituted by VMOU reviews every challenge. Objections found valid are incorporated into the final answer key, which then forms the basis for the official result.

What does the Asterisk (*) mean in the RPSC answer key?

Several questions across subjects carry an asterisk (*) mark in the RPSC Senior Teacher Final Answer Key 2026. This is an important notation that every candidate should understand before calculating their expected score.

An asterisk (*) in the RPSC answer key means that the particular question has been officially deleted by the Rajasthan Public Service Commission. All candidates who appeared for that paper will receive full marks for the deleted question, regardless of whether they attempted it or which option they chose. This is a standard practice followed by RPSC whenever a question is found to be ambiguous, incorrect, out of syllabus, or disputed during the answer key challenge process.

How to Calculate Your Expected Score Using the RPSC Answer Key

Once you have downloaded the subject-wise final answer key, you can estimate your score by following the scoring pattern used by RPSC for the Senior Teacher competitive examination.

  • Correct Answer: Check your response against the final answer key. If it matches, note it as correct.
  • Marks for Correct Answer: Each correct answer carries positive marks as per the exam's official marking scheme.
  • Deleted Questions: Add full marks for every question marked with (*) in your subject paper, as all candidates receive credit for deleted questions.
  • Negative Marking: RPSC typically applies negative marking for wrong answers. Refer to the official notification for the exact negative marking ratio applicable for this exam.
  • Final Score: Tally your correct answers and subtract deductions for wrong ones to get your estimated total score.

Role Snapshot
There has been an idea rolling around the association space that members sign up for economic reasons.

The gist of it is that you need to look at all your benefits and calculate a market price for each to present as the value of membership in your offer.

For Example:

  • Advocacy is worth $a because a lobbyist costs $b
  • Our benefits program offers potential savings of $c
  • Our help line is worth $d

After This Analysis, You Pitch Membership As:

"Membership is worth $5,700 and it only costs $300 a year. You'd be crazy not to join up!"

There Are a Couple Serious Errors With This Approach:

First off, people do not value things the same one person to the next. They will immediately discount all that they don't value and put a question mark about worth next to the items they do. "I don't go to the conference so who cares that you're offering a 20% discount for members... and I wouldn't pay $500 to a lobbyist if I weren't a member."

Secondly, people are not rational. Even if they did believe your calculations and had your same perception of value they still won't buy based on that.

Human beings don't marry the person who "makes sense," they want to fall in love. They don't go to the court house and save $15,000 on a wedding, they try and get everyone to fly to Puerto Rico for a destination wedding (thanks Antara.)

What Part of "You" Chooses?

People buy because of emotions: pain, desire, fear.

When we talk to each other, we sound like Spock from Star Trek, intelligent and logical. But inside of us it's, Days of Our Lives, "It was you!!! You murdered my psychic half sister because she divined that you were the owner of the ice cream parlor that fed my allergic yoga instructor rum raisin and put him into a coma... How could you!?"

A 2008 experiment using brain scanning technology found that people's brains made a decision up to a full 7 seconds before they consciously decided. They made their choice before they had the conscious experience of choosing. (Soon, C., Brass, M., Heinze, H. et al. Unconscious determinants of free decisions in the human brain. Nat Neurosci 11 543â545 (2008) doi:10.1038/nn.2112).

The unconscious part of you that wants and fears is driving the car. Spock is just sitting in the passenger seat, glaring at his GPS, and trying to make sense of where you're going.

Does all this mean that your shouldn't list the potential economic value of membership?

No. You just need to understand the difference between a persuading benefit and a rationalizing benefit.

Persuading Benefits vs. Rationalizing Benefits

A persuading benefit is any benefit that makes people want or fear. It drives behavior.

A rationalizing benefit is anything that makes them feel good about their decision to take a risk. It's how they explain why it was a good choice. The dollar value you put on membership is a tool they can use to rationalize their choice.

Research has shown that people feel regret over bad choices more deeply than positive feelings over good choices (Rozin, Paul; Royzman, Edward B. (2001). "Negativity bias, negativity dominance, and contagion". Personality and Social Psychology Review. 5 (4): 296â320. doi:10.1207/S15327957PSPR0504_2).

This negativity bias influences their decisions. A rationalizing benefit helps to defuse some of the risk by letting them know they can look back and say, "I made a reasonable choice."

Always lead with and emphasize persuading benefits and, if possible, follow with rationalizing ones.

For Example:

Book Yourself Solid With APSA's Business Mastermind (Persuading)

Then, Further Down In Your Offer:

Membership Makes Sense! Therapists Get Access to More Than $2,100 Worth Of Representation, Discounts, and Benefits. (Rationalizing).

People buy for the first reason and justify it using the second.

One final note: rarely, but still occurring, certain economic propositions *are* persuading benefits. This happens when the financial value is extraordinary, believable, and closely tied to a person's desires. E.g. Powerball numbers sell tickets.

In general though, just remember to speak to the stomach before you speak to the mind.

John Hooley

Role Snapshot
"They're not the only game in town anymore," a peer recently told me, "I bet they're having to learn how to compete like most private companies do."

We were discussing associations and the challenges of pitching membership. We live in a time of great abundance. The people that you'd like to become members have more options than ever. To pitch membership effectively, you must not only address their desires with a relevant offer, but you must also differentiate your association from every other alternative. Because of this, it's critical that your membership offer displays an element of uniqueness.

Why Uniqueness Matters

Consider buying a car. In 1908, if you wanted a car, the Model T was the only option available. In 2023, you can buy from a wide variety of cars and trucks. They all fulfill the purpose of transporting you and your cargo from point A to point B.

So why did you buy the car sitting in your driveway?

You Might

  • Have a van to transport a family.
  • An electric sedan because you value our environment.
  • A truck that supports your woodcraft hobby.

Because we have lots of options, cars are sold on what makes them unique from each other.

Membership is the same. Possible members have lots of options to connect, network, learn and get many of the other benefits you offer from other sources.

Because of this, your membership offer must address how the value you provide is unique.

Two Tests

There are two tests to determine if you're membership offer differentiates effectively.

  • (Tiny) Monopoly. You're the only type of solution that provides this kind of value. There aren't other competitors emphasizing the exact same thing. For example, if you believe that networking is highly relevant to a certain kind of potential member, it's not enough to say, "Become a member and get networking opportunities." There are lots of networking opportunities on LinkedIn, Meetup, and that popular private online community. You have to dive deeper and get more specific with something like, "Network with the most experienced and knowledgeable members in your industry."
  • How You're Different Matters. It's not enough just to be distinct. You have to be different in a way that a potential member cares about. You may be the only organization that sets standards or does legislative work. But if that's not valuable to who you're trying to get to join, then you'll have to differentiate on something they do care about. Being unique is always grounded by being relevant first.

Integrating Into Offer

The benefits in your membership offer must be relevant to who you're targeting. Relevance does the lion's share of the work. But to win out over other relevant competitors for a potential member's attention, you'll need to differentiate using uniqueness. To make a cooking analogy, relevance is the dish and uniqueness is the seasoning.

Relevance and uniqueness are the two bottom layers of Steward's, "Member Magnet Framework." The final layer is to address risk and I'll cover that in the next article.

Role Snapshot
Director of Operations, MSP Service DeliveryLocation: Fully Remote

bdManagedIT is a Managed IT Services Provider based in Madison, Georgia. We help businesses stay secure, supported, and running smoothly through reliable IT service, clear processes, and trusted relationships.

We are hiring a Director of Operations, MSP Service Delivery to help lead the day-to-day operational engine of the company. This role is responsible for creating structure, improving accountability, strengthening service delivery, and helping the team follow through on the right priorities.

The right person will be a hands-on operational leader who understands MSP service work. This person must be close enough to the work to guide priorities, spot what is stuck, hold the right people accountable, and keep the team moving.

This role is focused on leading the work, improving systems, and creating consistency. It is not built around personally fixing every technical issue.Key ResponsibilitiesService Delivery & Operations
  • Oversee daily operational flow across service delivery, projects, and internal priorities.
  • Help ensure tickets, projects, client commitments, and team responsibilities move with clarity and follow-through.
  • Guide service priorities, ticket flow, project handoffs, and escalation paths.
  • Identify blockers, recurring issues, service gaps, and process breakdowns.
  • Strengthen workflows, SOPs, communication, documentation, and accountability.
  • Create visibility into service quality, workloads, priorities, risks, and results.
  • Help reduce dependency on key individuals by building repeatable systems and stronger team ownership.
Service & Technical Operations Leadership
  • Use MSP service knowledge to guide priorities, ask informed questions, and support better operational decisions.
  • Participate in technical discussions when needed to clarify ownership, urgency, client impact, and next steps.
  • Help the team identify whether recurring problems are caused by process gaps, training gaps, unclear ownership, or technical issues.
  • Work with company leadership to improve service standards, operational maturity, and long-term scalability.
  • Keep tickets, projects, and technical decisions from drifting without clear ownership or follow-through.
People & Accountability
  • Lead, coach, and support managers, team leads, and technical team members.
  • Create clarity around roles, expectations, priorities, and performance standards.
  • Hold teams accountable to commitments, timelines, documentation, and client follow-through.
  • Address issues directly while maintaining a supportive, respectful culture.
  • Help team members solve problems at the system level instead of depending on one key person for answers.
Leadership Alignment
  • Work closely with ownership and leadership to align operations with business goals.
  • Turn leadership vision into clear execution, priorities, and measurable results.
  • Take company goals, turn them into clear priorities, assign ownership, remove roadblocks, and make sure the team follows through.
  • Support strong communication and coordination across departments.
  • Help the company scale with more structure, consistency, accountability, and operational rhythm.
What Weâre Looking For
  • Experience in MSP service delivery, technical operations, or a similar IT services environment.
  • Proven experience leading operations, service delivery, technical teams, managers, or team leads.
  • Strong understanding of how tickets, projects, escalations, client issues, and service priorities move through an MSP.
  • Working knowledge of MSP service delivery, technical operations, ticket flow, escalation paths, and service priorities.
  • Ability to understand technical issues well enough to ask good questions, guide priorities, and hold the right people accountable.
  • Ability to build repeatable systems, improve workflows, and create operational cadence.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with leadership, technical teams, and clients.
  • Strong follow-through, accountability, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Calm, organized, decisive leadership style.
  • Comfort balancing hands-on involvement with higher-level operational planning.
  • Ability to push accountability and address difficult issues without creating drama.
  • Bachelorâs degree preferred, not required. Equivalent MSP, IT services, service delivery, technical operations, or operations leadership experience will be considered.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a Managed Services Provider, IT services, or technical services environment.
  • Familiarity with service delivery metrics, SLAs, project workflows, escalation management, operational KPIs, and technical service standards.
  • Experience helping a growing company move from owner-dependent operations to scalable systems and stronger team accountability.
Role ClarityThis role is built for a hands-on operational leader who can stay close to service delivery without becoming the day-to-day technical fixer.

The Director of Operations, MSP Service Delivery will lead operational rhythm, service accountability, workflow improvement, and team follow-through. Technical knowledge matters, but the primary value is knowing how to guide priorities, ask good questions, spot bottlenecks, and make sure the right person owns the right issue until it is resolved.What This Role Is Not
  • This role is not a strategy-only position. It requires translating leadership vision into structured execution and measurable operational results.
  • This role is not a traditional ticket-level Service Manager, technical escalation point, or technical architect role. While this person will be close to service delivery and will help lead the operational rhythm of the service team, the primary value is building structure, creating accountability, improving workflows, and making sure the right people own the right issues. It is not focused on driving rapid change for its own sake. It is responsible for building sustainable systems, reinforcing accountability, and protecting operational rhythm as the company scales.
  • This role requires patience with process, consistency in execution, and comfort working within structure. If you are most energized by launching new initiatives or pursuing big ideas without sustained follow-through, this may not be the right fit.
Why bdManagedIT
  • Leadership team that values clarity, trust, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how the business operates, delivers service, and scales.
  • Growing organization with room to shape systems, structure, technical maturity, and culture.
  • Collaborative, no-nonsense environment focused on doing good work.
Benefits & Perks
  • Medical benefits
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid holidays
  • Supportive leadership culture focused on accountability, clarity, and continuous improvement
  • Additional benefits and details will be discussed during the interview process.
Location & Work ArrangementThis is a fully remote position. Occasional travel may be required for leadership planning, team coordination, or business needs.CompensationExpected base salary range will be commensurate with experience.How to Apply
  • Apply with your resume and complete the application questionnaire. Qualified candidates will be contacted to begin our structured interview and assessment process.
  • To help protect applicants from recruiting scams, bdManagedIT does not make job offers without an interview process and will not request banking information, credit card information, payment, or money transfers as part of the application or interview process.

No Phone Calls
Please no phone calls or direct inquiries regarding this position. Qualified candidates will be contacted as part of the interview process.

NeuLife Rehabilitation, Inc. is seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) to lead the organization's people strategy across multiple states and service lines. Position Summary

The CHRO provides strategic and operational leadership for all aspects of Human Resources, including talent acquisition, employee relations, compensation and benefits, compliance, payroll oversight, HRIS management, leadership development, performance management, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.

 Strategic Leadership

Mergers & Acquisitions

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Development

HR Operations & Technology

Performance & Analytics

Role Snapshot
Who We Are

OWL Services is the premier sales, installation, program management and service provider to retail, commercial, fleet, aviation and marine, and emergency power generation companies across the U.S.

With 33 offices and distribution centers and more than 1,400 field service professionals, OWL delivers on a service platform that includes construction, compliance and testing, maintenance and repair, modernization and re-imaging, and EV charging solutions to keep businesses and people moving 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

OWL Servicesâ companies have received numerous awards over the years for exemplary customer service. Most recently it was the recipient of EVgoâs Deployment Excellence Award in its first-ever class of awardees in the National EV Charging Recognition Program.

Come join us! For more information visit OWLServices.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

The Role:

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Warehouse & BI team and help us expand the reach, depth, and operational impact of our modern data platform. This is a hands-on role focused on report development, model expansion, and the ongoing reliability of a production analytics stack that already drives company-wide reporting.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business, including operations, finance, dispatch, inventory, vendor management, and others. You need to be an expert at building and maintaining these relationships. They will help give you the context and information needed to deliver reporting and insights that enhances how the business runs.

Our source systems are varied and disparate, with multiple ERPs, each carrying its own schema, conventions, and quirks. A core part of the job is reconciling those differences and producing a sanitized & harmonized view where the business can compare like-for-like across entities and source systems. If you enjoy untangling messy data and turning it into something trustworthy, then this is the place for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop, maintain, and extend Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and alerting across finance, operations, inventory, dispatch, and vendor management
  • Write and optimize complex SQL against Snowflake to investigate data, build models, and answer business questions
  • Build and refactor dbt models that standardize and harmonize data extracted from multiple ERPs into a unified, comparable schema
  • Setup the data in scalable and consumable way to enable the organization to be most well suited humans and agents
  • Reconcile disparate source-system definitions (chart of accounts, item masters, customer and vendor records, transaction types) so the business sees a true apples-to-apples view
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to elicit requirements, understand operational context, and translate business questions into reliable reporting
  • Proactively surface findings, anomalies, and improvement opportunities discovered in the data
  • Monitor Fivetran connectors, dbt runs, and Power BI refreshes; triage and resolve data quality and pipeline issues
  • Respond to ad-hoc data requests that drive business decisions and initiatives
  • Document data models, definitions, and report logic so knowledge is shared, not siloed

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of professional experience as a data analyst, analytics engineer, or BI developer
  • Extremely strong SQL skills, including comfort with CTEs, window functions, indexing, stored procedures, performance tuning, and debugging complex joins across large datasets.
  • Understanding of relational databases and scalable design.
  • Extremely strong Power BI skills, including:
    • DAX and data modeling
    • Calculation groups
    • Alerting and operational enablement, including integration with Power Apps
    • Performance tuning, row-level security, and report design best practices
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake or OneLake referred) and modern ELT patterns
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the interpersonal skills to build trust and productive working relationships with business stakeholders
  • Self-directed and comfortable working remotely and driving work without daily oversight
  • Forward-thinking mindset with demonstrated experience using AI tools to enhance and accelerate analytics work, including model development, DAX authoring, documentation, code review, and stakeholder communication

Compensation And Benefits

  • 10 Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off
  • 401(k) Company Match
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Disability & Occupational Accident Insurance
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance Policy
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • World-class paid training program for you to learn the skills for long term career success.

About the Role

Most product managers learn about customers secondhand, through tickets, surveys, and sales calls. This role is different.

At Brilliant Harvest, our customers are heavy equipment dealerships. Their customers are farmers and construction equipment operators. Growth Product Manager owns the product surface that turns a newly signed dealer into an active, self-sufficient one and then into a reference customer. That means building the features, flows, and feedback loops that drive activation and retention, informed by being in the field with the people actually using the product.

This is a growth role, but customer success is in its DNA. You'll work closely with our CS team but your job is to take what that world surfaces and turn it into product decisions that scale.

\n


Key Responsibilities

Own the Growth Loop

  • Define and own product growth metrics: activation rates, feature adoption, time-to-value, and retention across the dealer base.

  • Identify where dealers stall in the product journey and build solutions, whether that's a better onboarding flow, an in-app prompt, or a new feature that removes a blocker.

  • Design and run experiments to improve adoption. Prioritize ruthlessly based on what moves the metrics.

  • Work with Engineering, Design, and Technical Product Managers to ship growth features fast and learn from them.

Customer Understanding & Feedback Loop

  • You genuinely understand customer success not as a concept, but as something you've lived. You've been in the field. You've sat with customers through the messy middle, after the deal is signed and before they're actually running on their own.

  • Understand the dealership business model, including key metrics, operational pressures, and day-to-day workflows. Additionally, maintain a deep understanding of the end userâsuch as farmers and operatorsâto ensure the platform effectively addresses their needs.

  • Translate what you hear in the field into structured product insight. Not a running list of complaints, real signal that drives roadmap decisions.

  • Be the connective tissue between what CS experiences with customers and what the engineering team builds. Close that loop.

Product-Led Customer Enablement 

  • Design onboarding, education, and activation experiences as core product features to accelerate time-to-value, reduce user friction, and minimize support dependency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CS to identify and resolve process bottlenecks, decreasing implementation risk and shortening iteration cycles.

  • Capture customer victories and transform them into actionable product insights, ensuring that users continuously inform the roadmap to prioritize high-value impact.

Product Communication

  • Write product updates and dealer-facing communications that actually land,  the kind a service writer would read and understand.

  • Make sure customer feedback has a home in the product process, not just a running channel somewhere.


Qualifications & Skills
  • 3â5 years in product management, with experience owning growth, activation, or retention metrics â ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Background in customer success, account management, or field enablement, you've been in front of customers through the hard parts, not just analyzed them from a distance.
  • B2B2C experience: you understand what it means to drive value at two layers of a customer relationship simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with how equipment dealerships operate is a strong plus, service departments, parts counters, the way things actually work on the floor.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority, cross-functionally, and with customers who didn't ask for change.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You define the problem, find the signal, and decide what to build â without waiting to be told.
  • Strong communicator, written and verbal. You can present to a shop floor crew or a leadership team and adjust accordingly.
  • Data-literate. You know how to set up a metric, interpret results, and change course based on what you learn.
  • Willing and able to travel up to 10% â dealerships, farm sites, wherever the customers are.


What Will Set You Apart?
  • You've worked in or adjacent to a CS team and felt the frustration of watching the same product gaps create the same customer problems â and you want to be the person who fixes them upstream.
  • You've driven adoption of a new tool or process inside a business that didn't ask for change â and it stuck.


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing team led by Remi Schmaltz, an entrepreneur with decades of experience launching and growing agriculture businesses. 

  • Remote-first role with a flexible work environment.

  • A front-row seat to how AI is changing the way equipment dealers, farmers, and contractors work.

  • A collaborative culture that values growth, learning, and impact.

  • Competitive compensation, ESOP, and benefits.

Role Snapshot

Please note: a portfolio or work samples are required to be considered. Applications that include relevant, social-first examples reflecting the kind of editing this role calls for will be prioritized.


About the role

The Narrative Refinery is a boutique social media strategy and content production agency working with a roster of small but design-conscious brands. From July 20 to early August, the agency owner is on-site at a major international sporting event and needs a skilled social-first designer to own content editing for four clients during that window.


This starts as a part-time, project-based contract with a defined budget and scope. For the right person, there's a real opportunity to grow into an ongoing part-time role as the agency owner's go-to editor beyond this initial window.


Before the window begins, you'll have an onboarding call in early July with the agency owner to walk through the brands, briefs, file systems, and exact scope, so you're fully set up before the agency owner travels.


Shot lists and brand materials will be handed over before the project begins. Photographers deliver the raw assets. Your job is to turn that raw footage and photography into polished, on-brand, postable content, both graphics and short-form video, ready to be captioned and scheduled.


If you're a fast, proactive editor who loves social-first work and can match a brand's look without hand-holding, this is for you.


Who you are

  • Proactive and self-directed. You take a brief and run with it rather than waiting for step-by-step direction
  • Experienced specifically in social-first content, not just general graphic design. You understand the difference between a brochure and a Reel
  • Comfortable with fast turnarounds and juggling several brands at once without dropping quality
  • Skilled in both graphic design and video editing
  • Able to study a brand's past content and documents and produce new assets that fit seamlessly
  • Reliable with communication and deadlines, especially with the agency owner working in a different time zone and largely in the field


What you'll do

  • Edit raw photo and video assets into finished, postable content for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
  • Produce both static/carousel graphics and short-form video (Reels, TikToks, Stories)
  • Match each client's existing branding, guidelines, and content style by reviewing their past posts and brand documents
  • Work to provided shot lists and content briefs, with quick turnarounds across multiple brands
  • Deliver organized, clearly labeled final files ready for captioning and scheduling
  • Flag questions early and manage your own time across a steady editing load


The clients you'll be editing for

You'll be editing for four boutique, design-conscious small businesses, each with its own established look, voice, and audience. The work spans beauty, lifestyle, retail, and local services, from polished and premium to warm and community-focused. You'll move fluidly between very different aesthetics, sometimes in the same week, so range and adaptability matter more here than any single signature style.


The scope and how the work flows

This is a focused, time-boxed engagement, not a full month of output. During the window, you'll be editing a defined batch of content across the four clients, a steady but manageable mix of feed posts, Stories, and short-form video for Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. The exact volume and priorities will be set together during onboarding so the load is clear and realistic before anything begins.


A good portion of the work can be templatized to keep output efficient and consistent, and you'll receive clear briefs that lay out copy, inspiration, and each brand's look and feel. Your job is to match that brief to the right images and video delivered by the photographers after each shoot.

Why this role is worth your time


This isn't faceless overflow work. You'll be the editing engine behind a tight, well-run agency with clear systems, organized briefs, and clients who care about their content. You'll get clean shot lists, brand documents, and direction up front, not vague asks and mystery deliverables. For a designer who wants steady, interesting social-first work across varied brands, with a real path to an ongoing role, this is a strong foundation.


What success looks like

  • Raw assets come back from the photographers and get turned around into finished, on-brand content within the agreed window
  • Each client's content looks like it was made by someone who knows the brand, not a stranger
  • Editing can be handed off and trusted to be handled, keeping the agency owner focused in the field
  • Files come back organized, correctly named, and ready to caption and schedule with no rework


How we'll work together

  • You'll receive brand kits, past content, shot lists, and briefs beforehand
  • Work is delivered through shared drives with a clear folder and naming structure
  • The agency owner will be reachable for questions but largely in the field and in a different time zone, so proactive communication and good judgment matter
  • Turnarounds are quick but defined. You'll always know what's due and when


Logistics at a glance

  • Location: fully remote
  • Structure: part-time, project-based, defined budget, with potential to extend into an ongoing part-time role
  • Onboarding: a call in early July to align on brands, briefs, and scope before the window begins
  • Role Timeline: concentrated work from approximately July 18 to August 8, 2026
  • Time commitment: ~15-20 hours per week
  • Software: work in the tools that let you hit the brief; Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, and Canva are all in active use


A few things that will make you stand out

  • A portfolio that shows range across multiple brand aesthetics, not one signature style applied to everything
  • Examples of short-form video you've edited from raw footage, not just templated motion graphics
  • Evidence you can match an existing brand rather than impose your own
